ABOUT THE ROLE

Prose is looking for a Scientific Communication Manager to shape the brand's scientific storytelling and claims strategy. Sitting at the intersection of R&D, Brand, Innovation and Digital Product, this person will be the driving force behind a stronger, sharper scientific culture at Prose - translating complex research into compelling, credible, and differentiating content, while ensuring every claim we make is substantiated.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role for someone who is equal parts scientist, storyteller, and strategist. The role reports to the Director of Scientific Affairs & Sustainability within the Prose Science Team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

SCIENTIFIC COMMUNICATION STRATEGY

  • Shape Prose's global scientific communication strategy, aligned with brand positioning and priorities.

  • Establish the narrative structure and tone of voice that define our scientific authority across the key communication territories and ingredients that set us apart

  • Translate ingredient information and product testing data into clear, engaging narratives and claims

  • Act as a creative catalyst on new ingredients, technology, and testing communication opportunities.

TECHNICAL & CLAIMS DOSSIERS

  • Review and approve final test results, providing technical interpretation in collaboration with partner teams.

  • Build and maintain robust technical and scientific dossiers for new product launches and renovations (literature reviews, scientific territories, active ingredients, performance test results).

  • Support the preparation of oral presentations, posters, and peer-reviewed articles when relevant.

SCIENTIFIC & COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE

  • Maintain active scientific and competitive watch to identify new technology, ingredients, communication territories (longevity, exposome, microbiome…) and claims opportunities.

  • Prospect new raw materials, biological targets, and technologies through supplier relationships (in partnership with the R&D team) and competitive/technical intelligence.

  • Stay at the forefront of cosmetic trends, both from a marketing and a scientific standpoint, to provide marketing teams with structuring and differentiating strategic input.

SCIENTIFIC CULTURE & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Infuse a strong scientific culture across the organization - building dialogue and proximity between science and non-scientific teams.

  • Partner closely with R&D, Marketing, CX and Digital Product to ensure product claims and launch concepts are scientifically accurate and consistent, review all the communications assets and supports and answer ad hoc scientific and technical questions to support their day-to-day work

  • Work closely with the Evaluation team to coordinate clinical, instrumental, and consumer testing, and help design differentiating, creative claims approaches.

  • Partner with regulatory affairs to ensure substantiation needs are met and test platforms address all product claims.

  • Effectively articulate highly technical or complex scientific concepts to audiences with varying levels of scientific literacy.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong scientific/technical background (cosmetic science, dermatology, biology, or related field), with the ability to move fluidly between deep science and brand storytelling.

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in scientific communication, claims substantiation, or R&D-marketing liaison roles, ideally in beauty/cosmetics or a related regulated industry.

  • Strong appetite for AI tools and agentic AI, with a genuine curiosity for experimenting with several AI-amplified projects

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French a plus, given cross-team collaboration).

  • A creative thinker who challenges the status quo and looks for differentiating angles, not just correct ones.

  • Solution- and business-oriented mindset - resourceful in finding answers when data isn't readily available.

  • Comfortable as both a strategic thinker and a hands-on doer; flexible and able to adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • A natural team player and cross-functional leader, able to build trust with scientific and non-scientific stakeholders alike.

  • Rigorous, tenacious, results-oriented, with strong project management skills.

Prose Values

Intentional Inclusivity

  • We know the best ideas come from open minds and willingness to listen. While our products cater to the individual, an invitation into our process is always open to our community.

  • We value our differences and diverse backgrounds by communicating openly, managing with transparency and striving to understand one another’s perspective. It’s a key ingredient to our innovation.

Connected Collaboration

  • Our strength as a group will outlast our efforts as individual contributors. With offices across countries, staying inventive and agile deepens our clear vision and consistent communication.

  • We stay in a spirit of entrepreneurial collaboration: We do not have consensus at all times, but we trust one another to work toward our common goals. Our success is an expression and result of our progressive and gratifying teamwork.

Driven, Together

  • We value ownership and coaching that encourages employees to think constructively and creatively about the business. We view employees as leaders and individuals who are accountable, resourceful and responsible. Anyone and everyone is encouraged to lead.

  • We recognize that in order to continue thinking one step ahead, we will need to try new things. We strive to provide an open environment that accepts this truth, making space for new ideas to emerge.

Humanity Always

  • We assume good intentions in every interaction, keeping ourselves accountable for the climate we create. We seek to understand our co-workers through this lens of conscious benevolence, authenticity and fellowship.

  • We operate with the intention of preserving resources, creating an environment we can all live in – for our business and the world. Sustainable care is essential to our ethos as an organization. We take a mindful approach to how we think about our people (employees) and our planet.

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Full time
jobs.description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Engineer to work on the multi-agent pipeline turning raw, fragmented data into expert-grade real estate deliverables. You will make it more reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from the best human teams, then push it past what any human team could do, owning the stack end to end, from context engineering and orchestration to verification, storage and evaluation.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Where We Operate

Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions, each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more.

The Role

You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do.

You can expect to:

  • Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows.

  • Own the system end to end: infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale.

  • Ensure production-grade quality, performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients.

  • Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations.

Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale.

  • Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times.

  • Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits.

  • Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display).

  • Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time.

What We're Looking For

  • 1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance).

  • Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems.

  • Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs).

  • Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture).

  • Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning).

  • Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis.

  • Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase.

Nice to Have

  • Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production.

  • GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding).

  • Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules).

  • NLP background

Why Join Us

You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

  • Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation.

  • Real-world impact: your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

  • High ownership: own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

  • A small team with high standards - we ship fast and love working together.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. This is a great time to join us!

The Role

Product development at Nabla is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads. Each squad owns a product area end to end, with a product manager, a group of engineers, and the subject matter experts the work requires.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of the Dictation squad: a product that clinicians touch many times a day, that is critical to their day to day efficiency, and strategically pairs with Nabla's ambient product to cover all user settings.

This role sits at the intersection of ML, user experience, and customer success. You will work day to day with ML, backend, and frontend engineers on a product where model performance is only half the story. The other half is the interface, the latency, the recovery path when something goes wrong, and the dozens of small frictions that decide whether a clinician keeps using the product or quietly walks away. You will also be the one who pulls the right insight out of user feedback and supports the rollout of the product inside large health systems. Expect to reason about model quality and evaluation with your ML engineers one hour, then join a design review, dig through user feedback, or sit down with a client the next.

Above all, this is a role for someone with genuine curiosity about how clinicians work. You will spend real time with users, including regular visits to client sites in the US, watching how they move through their day and where our product costs them seconds they cannot spare. The best ideas here come from observation.

Nabla is growing fast and our users expect more of us every day. If you like owning a product end to end, care about the details, and want your work judged by whether clinicians actually adopt it, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Nabla Dictation product, be accountable for its adoption and the quality-of-life improvements it delivers to clinicians.

  • Lead user-centric discovery: run interviews, dig into user feedback, shadow clinicians, and leverage usage data to find the frictions worth removing.

  • Work day to day with ML, backend, and frontend engineers to turn model capabilities into a product that becomes essential to clinician's day to day, making the trade-offs between quality, latency, cost, and time to market.

  • Partner with Design to make sophisticated technology feel simple, including the edge cases and failure paths that determine whether clinicians trust it.

  • Support deployment with our clients, including enterprise health systems: build strong relationships with Nabla champions and keep key stakeholders informed as the product evolves.

  • Define what good looks like: set the quality bar and the metrics that track it, from model performance through to adoption, retention, and support burden.

  • Prioritize ruthlessly between ambitious bets and the steady grind of removing friction, and be able to explain why.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in a technical or engineering-heavy environment.

  • Experience working closely with ML teams on products where model quality drives user value, and comfort discussing evaluation, quality metrics, and iteration loops with ML engineers.

  • Strong user empathy and a real appetite for diving deep into user workflows, with a track record of removing friction that others had accepted as normal.

  • Excellent product judgment and UX sensibility: you identify the high-value problems, define a strategy, and ship improvements users actually notice.

  • Proven ability to collaborate with frontend, backend, and ML engineers and to earn credibility with them.

  • Strong analytical skills: you define success metrics, read product data, and combine qualitative and quantitative evidence to decide.

  • Clear, structured communication, with the ability to explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information, competing priorities, and high ownership.

  • Location and language: based in our Paris office, with regular travel to client sites in the US. Full professional fluency in English is required; French is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in healthcare, or in another regulated or safety-critical industry.

  • Experience with speech, real-time, or other latency-sensitive products.

  • Prior software engineering experience, or the ability to write scripts and reason about system logs, API schemas, and data models.

  • Experience with B2B products used every day in demanding frontline workflows.

  • Experience building for the US market.

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Stay humble

The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.

This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.

You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.

Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.

This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.

Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.

Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:

  • Self-serve clinicians, who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

  • Mid-market and enterprise health systems, managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.

Feature Launch Positioning & Activation

  • Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

  • Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

  • Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

  • Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

  • Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

Lifecycle Strategy and Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

  • Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:

    • For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

    • For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

  • Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

  • Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

Experimentation and Analytics

  • Lead a rigorous experimentation roadmap: A/B and multivariate testing of messaging, creative, cadence, segmentation, and value propositions

  • Define and own lifecycle KPIs, building reporting frameworks and sharing regular performance insights with marketing and cross-functional leadership

  • Partner with Data and Analytics on audience segmentation, behavioral signals, and AI-driven insights to enhance personalization at scale

  • Turn cohort and usage insights into concrete messaging and product-marketing actions

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, Product Ops, Clinical, and Brand to align lifecycle programs with broader business goals and the practitioner experience

  • Establish a clear, repeatable process across Product Marketing, CSM, PM, and Design for planning and shipping campaigns

  • Ensure all programs are developed and executed in compliance with HIPAA and applicable federal and state laws, partnering with Legal and Compliance as needed

Operations and Tooling

  • Take ownership of the full communication stack, starting with Userpilot

  • Evaluate and manage lifecycle marketing technology partnerships, recommending optimizations as we scale

  • Build and maintain process documentation, campaign playbooks, and training materials on internal platforms

  • Leverage AI tools as a core part of daily work (drafting, research, iteration) to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-5 years in B2B product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or product-led growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of in-app channels

  • Proven ability to craft positioning and messaging for product launches and to ship it yourself, not hand it off

  • Deep expertise across the full post-signup funnel (onboarding, activation, engagement, retention)

  • Strong Product DNA, with sharp attention to user workflows and the details that shape the product experience

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate complex data into clear hypotheses, actionable insights, and business recommendations

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to manage stakeholder expectations, influence without authority, and build alignment across diverse teams

  • Track record of building and scaling programs that drove measurable growth in adoption, engagement, and retention

  • Comfortable in a highly regulated, high-stakes industry (healthtech) with demanding clients, where accuracy, security, and compliance are non-negotiable

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Userpilot and HubSpot

  • Familiarity with Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Experience in a regulated industry: healthcare, behavioral health, or health-adjacent

  • Experience with AI-powered personalization, segmentation tools, or ML-informed campaign optimization

  • Experience marketing to a professional or clinical end user

Working closely with our CFO and Finance Manager, you will gain hands-on experience in financial operations, reporting, and analysis across our French and US entities.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing health tech scale-up, sharpen your technical finance skills, and learn how to operate in an international, high-growth environment — all while making an impact on the future of healthcare.

What you'll do:

Finance Operations & Reporting

  • Participate in monthly financial reporting for both US and French entities (Balance Sheet, P&L, KPIs, activity-based tracking).

  • Assist with maintaining and updating financial dashboards and reporting tools.

  • Support external accountants during monthly closings, annual financial statements, and audits.

  • Help prepare budget cycles and rolling forecasts dashboards.

  • Participate in cash management activities (cash flow tracking, currency exposure monitoring).

Process Improvement & Compliance

  • Help implement internal financial controls and workflows.

  • Contribute to improving revenue processes (invoicing, follow-up, reporting).

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide ad hoc financial analysis to support the CFO, CEO, and business teams (Sales, CS, Marketing).

  • Assist with financial presentations and board materials.

  • Collaborate with Strategy & Operations, People and Business teams on finance-related projects.

Your DNA:

  • Currently enrolled in a top-tier business school with a strong interest in corporate finance, accounting, or financial strategy.

  • First internship experience in finance, audit, M&A, or transaction services.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Proactive, hands-on, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both English and French.

  • Comfortable working independently and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

  • Meal vouchers

  • Public transportation costs covered at 50%

  • Outstanding offices in the heart of Paris (3ème, Arts et Métiers)

  • Weekly exercise classes during work hours: yoga, running, HIIT

  • Culture of trust & accountability

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

jobs.title: Senior taloushallinnon asiantuntija
jobs.description:
Etsimme ROAR Accountsille kokenutta ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää taloushallinnon asiantuntijaa vahvistamaan kasvavaa tiimiämme.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset vastaamaan asiakasyritystemme kirjanpidosta ja palkanlaskennasta kokonaisvaltaisesti. Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on vahva ammattitaito, pitkä käytännön kokemus ja kyky huolehtia asiakkaiden taloushallinnosta luotettavasti myös vaativammissa tilanteissa.

**Mitä tehtävä sisältää?**

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- asiakasyritysten kuukausittainen kirjanpito

- tilinpäätökset ja veroilmoitukset

- arvonlisäveroilmoitukset ja muut viranomaisilmoitukset

- palkanlaskenta ja siihen liittyvät ilmoitukset

- asiakkaiden neuvonta kirjanpidon, palkanlaskennan ja taloushallinnon kysymyksissä

- asiakasyritysten talouden seuraaminen ja lukujen avaaminen ymmärrettävään muotoon

- itsenäinen vastuu omista asiakkuuksista ja niiden laadukkaasta hoitamisesta

- tiimin tukeminen vaativimmissa asiantuntijakysymyksissä


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Toivomme sinulta:

- vähintään 7–10 vuoden monipuolista kokemusta kirjanpidosta ja taloushallinnosta

- vahvaa ja käytännössä osoitettua palkanlaskennan osaamista

- kokemusta tilinpäätösten ja veroilmoitusten itsenäisestä laatimisesta

- ajantasaista vero- ja taloushallinnon lainsäädännön tuntemusta

- huolellista, järjestelmällistä ja vastuullista työotetta

- ohjelmisto-osaaminen Netvisor ja Procountor ohjelmistoista on välttämätöntä

- hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- kykyä hallita omaa työtä, aikatauluja ja useita asiakkuuksia samanaikaisesti

- halua auttaa yrittäjiä ymmärtämään yrityksensä taloutta ja tekemään parempia päätöksiä


KLT-tutkinto, PHT-tutkinto tai muu taloushallinnon lisäkoulutus katsotaan eduksi.

Ratkaisevinta on kuitenkin vahva käytännön osaaminen ja pitkä kokemus sekä kirjanpidosta että palkanlaskennasta.

**Miksi Roar?**

ROAR Accounts on auktorisoitu ja yrittäjyyteen uskova valmentava tilitoimisto. Haluamme tarjota asiakkaillemme enemmän kuin lakisääteisen kirjanpidon: autamme yrittäjiä ymmärtämään yrityksensä lukuja, rakentamaan toimivia talouden rutiineja sekä kehittämään liiketoimintaansa kannattavasti ja kestävästi.

Roar on perustettu vuonna 2022, ja olemme kasvaneet määrätietoisesti selkeää ja suoraviivaista tilitoimistopalvelua tarjoavaksi asiantuntijayritykseksi. Palvelemme asiakkaita koko Suomessa.

Meillä pääset osaksi yrittäjähenkistä, sitoutunutta ja energistä tiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kirjanpidon, palkanlaskennan, liiketoiminnan kehittämisen, valmennuksen sekä myynnin ja markkinoinnin osaaminen. Arvostamme avointa yhteistyötä, oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua kehittää sekä omaa työtä että koko yrityksen toimintaa.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- vastuullisen ja monipuolisen asiantuntijatehtävän

- omat asiakkuudet ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työhösi

- osaavan, helposti lähestyttävän ja yrittäjähenkisen tiimin tuen

- kasvavan yrityksen tarjoamat kehittymismahdollisuudet

- mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa uudenlaista, valmentavaa tilitoimistopalvelua

- työyhteisön, jossa ammattitaitoon luotetaan ja hyvää tekemistä arvostetaan


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä meille hakemuksesi ja palkkatoiveesi tiina@roaraccounts.fi

Kerro hakemuksessasi erityisesti kokemuksestasi itsenäisestä kirjanpidosta, tilinpäätöksistä ja palkanlaskennasta sekä siitä, millaisia asiakkuuksia olet aikaisemmin hoitanut.

Tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten hakemus kannattaa lähettää mahdollisimman pian. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

jobs.title: Sijaisvanhempi, perhehoitaja
jobs.description:
**Oletko pohtinut lastensuojelun perhehoitajaksi ryhtymistä?**

Etsimme sijaisvanhempina toimivia sekä sijaisvanhemmuudesta kiinnostuneita pariskuntia ja yksinasuvia mukaan toimintaamme. Pienten lasten sijaisperheiden ohella kaipaamme myös perhehoitoperheitä ja sijaisvanhemmuudesta kiinnostuneita, joilla olisi valmiutta tarjota koti nuoruusikäiselle tai monikulttuurisen taustan omaavalle lapselle tai nuorelle. Sinulla ei tarvitse olla sosiaalialan koulutusta vaan aito halu kulkea yhteistä matkaa sijaishuoltoa tarvitsevan lapsen/nuoren kanssa sekä elämäntilanne, jossa mahdollistuu tavallinen, turvallinen perhearki ja lastensuojelutyö.

Sijaisvanhemmuus edellyttää pitkäjänteisyyttä sekä sitoutumista lapseen, minkä vuoksi perhehoitajaksi ryhtyminen vaatii harkintaa, omaan elämäntilanteeseen ja itseen perehtymistä sekä riittävästi tietoa siitä, mitä sijaisvanhemmuus ja lastensuojelussa tehtävä työ tarkoittaa. Harkintaprosessin ja tiedonsaannin tueksi tarjoamme maksuttoman, ryhmämuotoisen Pride- valmennuksen tai perhekohtaisen valmennuksen.

Olemme toimineet lastensuojelun sijaishuollossa 15 vuoden ajan ja myös itse perhehoitajina, joten tunnemme perhehoitajuuden arjen ja sen erityisyyden myös omakohtaisesti. Haluammekin tarjota perhehoitajille heidän, ja heille sijoitettujen lasten/nuorten tarpeisiin räätälöidyn ammatillisen tuen sijoituksen alusta loppuun eivätkä perhehoitajat jää työssään yksin.

Lastensuojelupalvelut Nummenlinna Oy on pieni, perheomisteinen toimija, jossa ihmiset tuntevat toisensa. Perhehoitajalle tämä tarkoittaa henkilökohtaista yhteydenpitoa, tuttua työntekijää ja matalaa kynnystä ottaa yhteyttä myös silloin, kun asia ei ole suuri, mutta sitä on hyvä pohtia yhdessä. Toisinaan pienikin juttuhetki voi auttaa asiassa eteenpäin. Teemme tarvittaessa myös tiivistä yhteistyötä perhehoitajan tukena lapsen/nuoren asioissa toimivan viranomaisverkoston, eri toimijoiden ja läheisten kanssa.

Perhehoitajille tarjoamme:

- Ammatillinen, perhekohtaisesti räätälöity tuki koko sijoituksen ajan

- Vertaistuki ja yhteisöllisyys; mahdollisuus osallistua työyhteisön yhteisiin koulutuksiin ja työhyvinvointipäiviin sekä perhehoitajien vertaistoimintaan

- Tarvittaessa erityistyöntekijämme (psykologi) konsultointi ja tapaamiset

- Työnohjaus

- Säännölliset vapaat ja sijaishoidon järjestelyt

- Hoitopalkkio sekä käynnistämis- ja kulukorvaus

- Tukityömme ja ennakkovalmennus on mahdollista toteuttaa tarvittaessa myös englanniksi


**Ennakkovalmennukset**

Alkuvuodesta 2027 aloitamme PRIDE-valmennuksen perhehoitajuudesta kiinnostuneille. Valmennus tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tutustua rauhassa sijaisvanhemmuuteen ja saada tietoa siitä, mitä sijaisvanhemmuus käytännössä tarkoittaa. Valmennukseen osallistuminen ei tarkoita vielä päätöstä perhehoitajaksi ryhtymisestä vaan tarjoaa tietoa sekä tilaisuuden pysähtyä pohtimaan omia valmiuksia ja elämäntilannetta yksilöllisen harkintaprosessin tueksi. Valmennuksesta vastaavat yrityksemme perhehoidosta vastaava sosiaalityöntekijä sekä perhehoitaja työparina. Valmennus sisältää ryhmämuotoisia ja perhekohtaisia tapaamisia, ja on kestoltaan n. 4-6kk.

Rejoignez-nous pour accompagner une étape clé de la transformation de notre pôle paie !

Qui sommes-nous ?

Avec 580 collaborateurs répartis sur 21 agences dans les Côtes-d'Armor, nous accompagnons le développement de 10 000 entreprises (agriculteurs, artisans, commerçants, professions libérales...) dans les domaines du conseil, de la gestion et de l'expertise comptable.

Votre mission : contribuer à la réussite d'une migration essentielle

Dans le cadre d'un changement de logiciel de paie, nous recherchons 2 collaborateurs en CDD de 6 mois (potentiellement reconductible) pour accompagner la migration de nos dossiers et garantir la fiabilité des données.

Vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans cette phase de transition. Votre mission ? Suivre un processus clairement défini, assurer une migration fiable des dossiers et contribuer au bon fonctionnement futur de notre pôle paie.

Concrètement, vos missions seront de :

- Saisir / traiter les données d'un logiciel à l'autre en suivant une méthodologie précise et un processus établi.
- Appliquer rigoureusement les procédures de migration afin de garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des données transférées.
- Vérifier les informations saisies et réaliser les contrôles nécessaires à chaque étape.
- Identifier les éventuelles anomalies / incohérences et les faire remonter.
- Assurer un suivi régulier de l'avancement des migrations.
- Respecter les consignes, les délais et les étapes de validation définies.
- Participer activement à la réussite de cette phase de transition, essentielle au bon fonctionnement de notre pôle paie.

Votre profil : la rigueur avant tout !

Pour réussir dans cette mission, pas besoin d'être un expert de la paie ! Nous recherchons avant tout des personnes rigoureuses, méthodiques et à l'aise avec les outils informatiques.

Nous recherchons des candidats qui :

- Aiment travailler avec des procédures claires et suivre un processus étape par étape.
- Sont particulièrement attentifs aux détails et à la qualité de leur travail.
- Sont à l'aise avec l'utilisation de logiciels informatiques et la saisie de données.
- Savent se concentrer sur des tâches nécessitant précision, répétition et fiabilité.

jobs.title: EDUCATEUR SPECIALISE - HDJ PICOT - pédopsychiatrie (H/F)
jobs.description:
Lieu de travail : HDJ Picot 6 rue Picot 76016 PARIS / Horaires : 9h - 16h30
Organisation du travail : Prise en charge d'enfants âgés de 6 à 12 ans présentant des troubles du comportement et porteurs de TND (TDA/H, TSA)

Poste d'ES - Travail en collaboration pluridisciplinaire (Médecin responsable d'unité , cadre de santé, 3 IDE, 3 ES, 1 orthophoniste, 1 psychomotricienne, 1 psychologue, 1 assistante sociale, 1 ASH , 1 secrétaire, 2 enseignantes spécialisées).

POSTE :

- Les ateliers thérapeutiques proposés sont co-animés, ils s'appuient sur des prises en charge portant sur les habiletés sociales, la remédiation cognitive, l'éducation thérapeutique du patient et la relaxation, afin de favoriser l'autonomisation et une meilleure sociabilité.

- Les repas pris à l'hôpital de jour sont thérapeutiques, c'est-à-dire accompagnés par l'équipe de l'HDJ.

- Il existe également des partenariats avec des structures extérieures, tels que Le Louvre pour un atelier spécifique et adapté aux enfants accueillis, ou le Théâtre de Chaillot, pour des spectacles.

- L'accès à des équipements sportifs de la ville de Paris ou de communes limitrophes permet certains ateliers sportifs (piscine, patinoire, stade).
- Un atelier théâtre avec un intervenant extérieur complète l'offre de soins.
- Utilisation et développement d'outils spécifiques (habiletés sociales, ETP, approche snoezelen, profils sensoriels .)
- Possibilités régulières de formations en lien avec la spécificité de l'unité.
- Des formations internes au service et centrées sur les profils d'enfants accueillis sont proposées à l'ensemble des professionnels soignants et éducatifs de l'IJ08


MISSIONS :

- Eduquer et accompagner, sous l'angle médico socioéducatif, des enfants présentant un diagnostic de troubles du neurodéveloppement (TSA, TDAH, troubles dys), troubles du développement psychologique, du comportement et de l'adaptation à la vie scolaire)

- Développer l'autonomie de l'enfant par une meilleure perception de lui-même et de ses relations avec les autres grâce à une démarche éducative méthodique, dynamique, individualisée, globale et interprofessionnelle

- Co-animation de groupes thérapeutiques, Travail d'observation clinique de l'enfant en individuel et en groupe
- Accompagnement du jeune patient et son entourage dans le cadre du projet thérapeutique.
- Participation aux synthèses cliniques hebdomadaires, aux réunions institutionnelles
- Participation à l'élaboration d'un projet personnalisé d'intervention revu régulièrement

L'éducateur(trice) spécialisé(e) est intégré à la coordination de l'action sociale et éducative : Les professionnels socio-éducatifs sont encadrés par des cadres socioéducatifs intervenant au sein d'une coordination de l'action sociale et éducative qui compte 250 professionnels socio-éducatif. Les professionnels recrutés pourront bénéficier ainsi d'un accompagnement à la prise de poste et d'un soutien technique.

Des formations spécialisées en travail social (exemple : groupe d'analyse de la pratique, veille juridique.) et en psychopathologie pourront leur être proposées. Selon les projets du service, ils pourront également demander des formations visant à se spécialiser dans certaines pratiques. Les différentes disciplines du GHU (addictologie, psychiatrie, somatique, médico-social, médecine générale et neurosciences cliniques) favorisent la construction d'une carrière professionnelle riche et diversifiée.


PROFIL :
- Diplôme d'Educateur(trice) spécialisé(e) exigé
- Expériences professionnelles en pédopsychiatrie et/ou en protection de l'enfance
- Connaissance des outils spécifiques à la prise en charge de l'autisme appréciées : Pec's, Makaton

MODALITES DE RECRUTEMENT POSSIBLES : CDD, mutation, ou détachement
SALAIRE selon la grille de la FPH (+ prime SEGUR) + prime de service pour les agents stagiaires et titulaires

CV et LM

jobs.title: Team Leader Production CEE (H/F)
jobs.description:
Effy est le spécialiste de l'efficience énergétique depuis 2008.

Nous aidons les propriétaires à rendre leur maison plus confortable, durable et économe grâce à notre expertise et à un réseau de plus de 4 000 artisans engagés.

- Atteinte des objectifs de production.
- Taux de conformité des dossiers déposés.
- Taux de rejet des dossiers.
- Respect des délais de traitement.
- Niveau de satisfaction des partenaires et clients.
- Taux de montée en compétences et polyvalence des équipes.

Profil :

- Excellente connaissance du dispositif des CEE (expérience de minimum 5 ans).
- Maîtrise des exigences réglementaires et des processus de conformité.

- Excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication.

- Utiliser les appareils de métrologie courants avec précision et méthode.
Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce descriptif et souhaitez contribuer à la performance qualité de notre client, postulez sans attendre.
Adecco s'engage à promouvoir la diversité et l'égalité des chances. Toute information liée à la candidature est traitée avec la plus stricte confidentialité.

jobs.title: Facility Manager
jobs.description:
Har du erfarenhet inom förvaltning, leverantörskontakter och ekonomisk uppföljning? Låter en blandning mellan operativt och strategiskt arbete som det bästa av två världar? Läs mer nedan om tjänsten som Facility Manager på vårt huvudkontor i Barkarby!

Din roll

Som Facility Manager tillhör du ett drivet strategiskt team på 8 kollegor, men i det dagliga arbetet driver du självständigt ditt eget ansvarsområde framåt. Ditt mål är att skapa de bästa tänkbara förutsättningarna för våra kollegor på kontoret, och se till att fastigheten drivs säkert och kostnadseffektivt. Arbetsdagarna rymmer både det operativa arbetet här och nu – som att följa upp felanmälningar, hantera fakturor och se till att allt fungerar på kontoret – och det mer strategiska. Du blickar hela tiden framåt, planerar service och underhåll, ser över leverantörsavtal och följer upp kostnader för att göra arbetsplatsen ännu bättre.

Rollen innebär varierande arbetsuppgifter, bland annat att:

    agera kravställare, beställare och huvudsaklig kontaktperson gentemot leverantörer
    delta i upphandlingar samt ansvara för och följa upp tjänsteleveranser
    vara kontaktperson internt för Facility Management-frågor
    säkerställa och följa upp drift- och myndighetskrav
    driva och bidra till kontinuerligt utvecklingsarbete

I din roll rapporterar du till teamchef Facility Management.

Din profil

För att vara framgångsrik i rollen har du en relevant utbildning och några års erfarenhet inom Facility Management. Du har koll på fastighetsteknik, trivs i digitala miljöer och drivs av att hitta smarta, kostnadseffektiva lösningar. Med din vassa kommunikativa förmåga navigerar du smidigt mellan olika önskemål och skapar långsiktiga relationer både internt och med leverantörer.

Vi ser även att du har:

    erfarenhet av kontorsförvaltning och budgetansvar, vilket är starkt meriterande
    goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
    körkort (bonus)

Vi erbjuder

För oss är det viktigt att våra medarbetare trivs - på alla sätt. Vi erbjuder därför ett arbete i en miljö som karaktäriseras av våra värdeord: prestation, respekt, tillit, jordnära attityd och gemenskap. Eftersom vi växer, kan du växa. Snabbt. Inom din roll, eller mot en annan. På samma plats, eller någon annanstans. Inom butik, lager, kontor. Lokalt, nationellt eller globalt. Vi stöttar dig på din resa mot mer ansvar och nya utmaningar.

Du blir del av ett stort team där alla kavlar upp ärmarna och hjälps åt. Ibland hittar du oss på vårt toppmoderna huvudkontor, där vi har tillgång till gym och härligt rabatterade priser i restaurangen. Men givetvis är vi också en flexibel arbetsplats med möjlighet till hybridarbete. Du får allt från friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrapenningtillägg och medarbetarrabatt i våra butiker till kostnadsfri rådgivning av psykolog, jurist och ekonom samt mängder av erbjudanden via vår förmånsportal. Självklart omfattas du också av kollektivavtal och tjänstepension. Vi möjliggör en rättvis lönesättning inom företaget genom ett icke-diskriminerande lönesystem. Vid fackliga frågor kontakta Unionens lokala fackklubb via e-postadressen unionenklubb_hk@lidl.se.

Vill du vara med på vår resa?

Om ditt svar är ja, då söker du jobbet såhär:

    Gå in via länken
    Fyll i formuläret
    Bifoga CV

Vår rekryteringsprocess består av urvalstester, telefonintervju, personlig intervju och referenstagning. Hör av dig till oss om du har ett särskilt behov av anpassning när det kommer till urvalstesterna.

Denna rekrytering sker med löpande urval, varför vi gärna ser att du skickar din ansökan snarast, dock senast den 6 oktober 2026.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning.

Har du frågor om tjänsten eller ansökningsprocessen, vänligen kontakta rekryteringsteamet på mail: jobbhk@lidl.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Om oss på Lidl

På Lidl händer det grejer precis hela tiden. Mellan doften av krispiga croissanter och ljudet av veckans kampanj som rullar ut i hyllorna finns en energi som smittar av sig. Vårt hemliga recept? Team Lidl – alla vi som hjälps åt för att allt ska klaffa. Hela vägen från lagergolven till butikshyllorna och kontoren. För oss är det lika självklart att vi levererar högsta kvalitet till branschens bästa pris som att ge dig ett tryggt jobb med schyssta förmåner och utrymme att utvecklas. Att vi är certifierade Top Employer och Karriärföretag är kvittot på att vi menar allvar. Ett jobb som lönar sig helt enkelt.

jobs.title: Ønsker du relevant HR-erfaring ved siden av studiene?
jobs.description:
Vi søker en engasjert HR-assistent som ønsker å få praktisk erfaring fra HR-faget i en virksomhet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag innen forsvar og luftfart.

I KAMS brenner vi for å utvikle mennesker, ledere og organisasjonen vår. Vi ønsker også å bidra til utviklingen av fremtidens HR-profesjonelle ved å gi muligheten til å omsette teori til praksis. Derfor ser vi etter deg som deler vår interesse for HR-faget, er nysgjerrig på hvordan HR skaper verdi i organisasjoner og ønsker å lære gjennom å få ansvar og bidra i ulike HR-prosesser.

Vi tror denne rollen passer spesielt godt for deg som tar studier innen HR, organisasjon og ledelse, og ønsker å bygge relevant arbeidserfaring ved siden av studiene. Vi ser gjerne at du har fullført minst andre studieår.

Hos oss skal det være mulig å kombinere studier og arbeid. Stillingen har et omfang på inntil 30%, men vi vet at studiebelastningen varierer gjennom året og vil derfor være fleksible innenfor avtalte rammer. Det vil være perioder hvor du kan jobbe mer, og perioder hvor studiene må prioriteres høyere. Sammen finner vi en løsning som fungerer for både deg og oss.

Stillingen er midlertidig med ønsket oppstart så snart som mulig og varighet frem til august 2027.

Om rollen

Som HR-assistent blir du en del av HR-teamet og jobber tett med våre HR-rådgivere. Du vil bidra med administrativ støtte i det daglige HR-arbeidet, samtidig som du får erfaring med sentrale HR-prosesser og mulighet til å bidra i utviklingsarbeid innen blant annet onboarding, employer branding og forbedring av HR-rutiner.

Hovedoppgaver og ansvar
  • Bistå HR-teamet i det daglige HR-arbeidet og administrative oppgaver
  • Bidra til onboarding, rekruttering og vedlikehold av HR-dokumentasjon
  • Oppdatere HR-informasjon og støtte oppfølging av HR-data og prosesser
  • Bidra i employer branding-aktiviteter
  • Delta i utviklings- og forbedringsarbeid innen HR
Vi ser etter deg som har
  • Arbeidserfaring fra servicebransjen
  • Brennende interesse for HR-faget og et ønske om å utvikle deg videre innen området
  • Påbegynt relevant utdanning innen HR, organisasjon og ledelse, og fullført minst andre studieår
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk
  • Mulighet til å sikkerhetsklareres opp til Norsk Hemmelig (se NSM.no for mer info)
Personlige egenskaper

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du:

  • Er nysgjerrig og ønsker å lære mer om HR-faget
  • Tar initiativ og liker å få ting gjort
  • Er strukturert og har god gjennomføringsevne
  • Samarbeider godt med andre og bygger gode relasjoner
  • Trives med varierte arbeidsoppgaver og en hektisk hverdag
  • Er positiv, serviceinnstilt og opptatt av å bidra til teamets mål
Hvem er vi?

Siden starten på militær luftfart i Norge har Kongsberg Aviation Maintenance Services (KAMS) spilt en viktig rolle i norsk luftfartsindustri.

I dag er vi en strategisk partner for Forsvaret og en leverandør i verdensklasse innen vedlikehold, reparasjon og overhaling av fly, helikoptre, motorer og komponenter.

I HR-teamet jobber vi bredt med alt fra rekruttering, onboarding og lederstøtte til organisasjonsutvikling, kompetanseutvikling, employer branding, arbeidsmiljø, medarbeideroppfølging og kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid. Hos oss får du muligheten til å lære av erfarne HR-medarbeidere, bygge et profesjonelt nettverk og skaffe deg erfaring som vil være verdifull videre i karrieren.

Vi tilbyr
  • Relevant arbeidserfaring i en spennende virksomhet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
  • Faglig utvikling og tett oppfølging fra erfarne HR-medarbeidere
  • Mulighet til å bidra både i daglige HR-prosesser og utviklingsarbeid
  • Et inkluderende, kompetent og utviklingsorientert arbeidsmiljø

Arbeidet utføres primært på dagtid og i samarbeid med HR-teamet på Kjeller.

Har du spørsmål om rollen?

Ta kontakt med

Anette Holthe
Senior HR-rådgiver
M: +47 416 61 481

eller

Maiken Tveito Hildebrandt
Senior HR-rådgiver
M: +47 938 14 931


Klar for å søke?

Registrer din søknad, CV og karakterutskrift via vårt rekrutteringssystem.
Søknader vurderes fortløpende, og vi ønsker oppstart så snart som mulig.

Stillingen forutsetter at kandidaten kan sikkerhetsklareres i henhold til gjeldende krav.

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

 


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Siden starten på militær luftfart i Norge har Kongsberg Aviation Maintenance Services (KAMS) og forgjengerne spilt en betydelig rolle i norsk luftfartsindustri. Vi har endret og tilpasset oss utviklingen innen luftfart, men vår dedikasjon til innovasjon og pålitelighet har aldri endret seg. I dag er vi mer ambisiøse enn noen gang og vi er utrolig stolte over å være en leverandør i verdensklasse av vedlikehold, reparasjon og overhaling på tvers av flere flyvende plattformer, inkludert fly og helikoptre, men også motorer og komponenter. KAMS er også en av leverandørene av nye deler til et av de største luftfartsselskapene i verden.

jobs.title: Construction - Foreperson
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.

Ensure Health, Safety, Environmental & Sustainability standards, policies and procedures are always adhered to on-site. Be familiar with the HSQE managements system and procedures in conjunction with the current statutory requirements. jobs.title: Capio Ögon söker operationssjuksköterska/ögonsjuksköterska
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta på en ny modern ögonklinik där hög medicinsk kvalitet, kirurgisk precision och nära samarbete står i fokus? Då kan Capio Ögon vara rätt plats för dig. Vi utökar nu vårt team och söker dig som är operationssjuksköterska eller ögonsjuksköterska.

Om oss

Capio Ögon bedriver ögonsjukvård på två moderna enheter i Stockholm. Vår ögonmottagning finns på Arenavägen 27 i Globen, medan vår operationsverksamhet bedrivs i nya lokaler på Sophiahemmet.

På operationsenheten genomför vi bland annat kataraktkirurgi inom ramen för vårt vårdavtal med Region Stockholm, privata synfelsoperationer och polikliniska operationer i privat regi. Mottagningen i Globen och operationsenheten på Sophiahemmet arbetar nära tillsammans för att skapa trygga patientflöden och en sammanhållen vård för våra patienter.

Hos oss arbetar du tillsammans med erfarna ögonläkare, operationssjuksköterskor, ögonsjuksköterskor, optiker och administrativ personal. Vi är en välfungerande verksamhet med starkt teamarbete, hög medicinsk kvalitet och ett genuint engagemang för patienterna. Tillsammans utvecklar vi kontinuerligt våra metoder, arbetssätt och patientflöden.

Din roll

Vi söker en legitimerad operationssjuksköterska eller ögonsjuksköterska till vår operationsenhet på Sophiahemmet. I rollen som sjuksköterska hos oss har du din huvudsakliga arbetsplats på operationsavdelningen på Sophiahemmet, där du arbetar fyra dagar i veckan. En dag i veckan tjänstgör du på vår ögonmottagning på Arenavägen 27 i Globen.

På operationsavdelningen arbetar du nära ögonläkare och övriga kollegor kring planerade ögonoperationer. Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar framför allt instrumentering vid operation, förberedelser inför operation och sterilhantering. Verksamheten har välfungerande patientflöden och genomför cirka 24 operationer per dag.

Kombinationen av operations- och mottagningsarbete ger en varierad arbetsvecka och möjlighet att bidra till ett nära samarbete mellan våra två enheter. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team som samarbetar över verksamheten. Vi lägger stor vikt vid en god introduktion, tydlig kommunikation och gemensamma arbetssätt, så att teamkänslan är stark oavsett arbetsplats.

Arbetstiden är förlagd till dagtid, måndag–fredag, inom intervallet kl. 08.00–16.30.

Vårt erbjudande

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en modern ögonverksamhet där patientsäkerhet, kvalitet och ett gott samarbete står i fokus. Du får en viktig roll i vår nya operationsverksamhet på Sophiahemmet och möjlighet att bidra med din kompetens i utvecklingen av våra arbetssätt och patientflöden.

Hos oss får du:

    

En varierad roll inom ögonkirurgi, med huvudsaklig tjänstgöring på operationsavdelning och viss tjänstgöring på ögonmottagning.

    

Arbeta i moderna lokaler på Sophiahemmet samt på en helt ny mottagningsverksamhet i Globen.

    

Ett kompetent, inkluderande och engagerat team med nära samarbete mellan olika professioner.

    

Möjlighet att påverka och utveckla metoder, flöden och arbetssätt.

    

Dagtidsarbete på vardagar, vilket ger en förutsägbar arbetsvecka.

    

Kollektivavtal och förmånlig tjänstepension.

    

Möjlighet till privat sjukvårdsförsäkring.

    

Friskvårdsbidrag och förmånscykel.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som har någon av följande bakgrunder:

    

Du är legitimerad ssk med specialistutbildning i ögonsjukvård och har erfarenhet av arbete med ögonoperationer, exempelvis instrumentering, operationsförberedelser och sterilhantering.

    

Du är legitimerad ssk med specialistutbildning i operationssjukvård, helst med erfarenhet av ögonkirurgi. Har du inte arbetat inom ögon tidigare ser vi gärna att du har ett tydligt intresse för ögonkirurgi och vill utveckla din kompetens inom området.

Krav

    

Legitimerad ssk med specialistutbildning i ögonsjukvård alt operationssjukvård

    

Goda kunskaper i svenska, i tal och skrift.

    

Ett noggrant och strukturerat arbetssätt med fokus på kvalitet, hygien och patientsäkerhet.

    

God samarbetsförmåga och ett professionellt bemötande av patienter och kollegor.

Meriterande

    

Erfarenhet av ögonkirurgi, särskilt kataraktkirurgi eller andra polikliniska ögonoperationer.

    

För dig som är operationssjuksköterska: erfarenhet av instrumentering, operationsförberedelser och sterilhantering inom ögonkirurgi.

    

Erfarenhet av arbete på ögonmottagning.

    

Erfarenhet av arbete i en verksamhet med högt patientflöde.

Som person ser vi gärna att du är ansvarstagande, flexibel och trygg med att ta egna initiativ. Du trivs i en vardag där arbetsuppgifter och tempo kan variera och uppskattar ett nära samarbete med kollegor från olika professioner. Vi lägger stor vikt vid din förmåga att bidra till en inkluderande arbetsmiljö och till utvecklingen av våra arbetssätt och patientflöden.

Anställningsvillkor

Tjänsten är en heltidsanställning med tillsvidareanställning och sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.

Ansökan

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Skicka därför gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta annsofie.axelsson@capio.se

I samband med anställning kan bakgrundskontroll och utdrag ur belastningsregistret komma att begäras.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Publicerat: 2026-09-21

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-21

jobs.title: HEAD OF TECHNICAL OPERATIONS AND NP CAMO
jobs.description:
Company description:

Scandinavian Airlines System SAS

Job description:  Description  

Do you want to lead the continuing airworthiness function for one of Scandinavia’s largest airline fleets?As Head of Technical Operations and NP CAMO, you will hold the regulatory responsibility for ensuring the airworthiness, safety, compliance, and cost-effective operation of the SAS fleet. Reporting directly to the Accountable Manager, you will lead the CAMO organization and play a critical role in ensuring that all continuing airworthiness activities are conducted in accordance with EASA regulations, company requirements, and operational objectives.This is a senior leadership role with significant operational, regulatory, organizational, and strategic responsibility.

     Challenges you will work on:  

•    Regulatory responsibility for airworthy, safe and economical operation of SAS's aircraft fleet under the limitation of the requirements imposed by European aviation regulations in accordance with EASA Part-CAMO and EASA Air Operations regulation.Main Tasks•    Ensure the development, updating and approval of the fleet's maintenance programs.•    Ensure that all maintenance requirements from manufacturers and authorities are evaluated, implemented and accomplished within the applicable compliance limits.•    Ensure the provision and preparation of approved documentation for all maintenance, repairs and modifications carried out on the aircraft fleet.•    Ensure that the aircraft with continuing airworthiness and approved configuration of the fleet are maintained in accordance with EASA Part-CAMO and Part-M, as applicable, and EASA Air Operations requirements, and that records are kept showing the airworthiness status.•    Ensure that all maintenance, including line maintenance and base maintenance, is planned and executed within the deadlines prescribed in the individual aircraft type maintenance programs and applicable maintenance programme limitations, approved maintenance data, and aircraft technical log requirements.•    Ensure that technical services for aircraft, engines and components are contracted in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, as well as SAS's operational and commercial requirements.•    Ensure the proper storage and management of flight documentation.•    Ensure that SAS's overall maintenance needs are carried out on competitive terms.•    Ensure that continuing airworthiness activities are performed in accordance with applicable requirements, approved procedures, and AOC conditions and limitations, and that aircraft airworthiness and regulatory compliance are maintained.•    Ensure hazards, occurrences, and non-compliances are identified, assessed, and addressed, and that appropriate corrective actions are implemented.•    Ensure clear lines of responsibility and escalation are established and maintained and shall, within the scope of delegated authority, assess and escalate risks affecting airworthiness to the Accountable Manager or other authorized decision-making level, as applicable.Managerial Responsibility and Mandate•    Legal and organizational responsibility for the tasks within Continuing Airworthiness Management.•    Personnel responsibility for all CAMO personnel, with direct leadership responsibility for the management team.•    Delegated budget responsibility for the operation of Technical Operations within SAS CAMO.•    Member of the Accountable Manager management team and contributor to achieving and developing company goals and objectives.

     The Team  

Continuing Airworthiness Management constitutes a key function within SAS operations and requires extensive collaboration across the organization.The role works closely with operational functions throughout SAS and maintains strong relationships with aircraft, engine and equipment manufacturers, maintenance providers, suppliers, and aviation authorities.As Head of Technical Operations and NP CAMO, you will lead the CAMO organization and its management team while supporting a culture focused on safety, compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

     To be successful we believe you have  

Key Competencies•    Extensive experience within Continuing Airworthiness Management and aviation technical operations. •    Strong knowledge of EASA Part-CAMO, Part-M, Part-145, and Air Operations requirements. •    Experience leading technical and operational teams in a complex, regulated environment. •    A relevant university degree in Engineering, Aviation Management, or a related field. •    Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills. •    Experience working with aviation authorities, aircraft manufacturers, and maintenance organizations. •    The ability to balance safety, compliance, operational performance, and commercial objectives. A strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach to leadership and execution.



In addition, we believe you are:•    A strong and inspiring leader with excellent stakeholder management skills.•    Comfortable operating in a highly regulated and complex operational environment.•    Strategic while maintaining a strong operational focus.•    Decisive and able to make informed decisions balancing safety, compliance, operational needs, and business objectives.•    A strong communicator who builds trust and collaboration across functions and organizations.•    Structured, accountable, and committed to maintaining the highest safety and compliance standards.

jobs.title: Biståndshandläggare äldreomsorg sökes för konsultuppdrag i Stockholms län
jobs.description:
Vill du bidra till gott socialt arbete och samtidigt uppnå din fulla potential? Till vår avtalskommun söker vi en socionom som har minst tre års erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom kommunal verksamhet.

Känner du att det är dags att ta nästa steg i karriären och vill veta mer om konsultlivet, eller är du redan socionomkonsult och intresserad av att bredda ditt professionella nätverk? Oavsett om du föredrar att arbeta som anställd eller underkonsult ser vi fram emot att du kontaktar oss. Vi berättar gärna mer om uppdraget och hur det är att arbeta som socionomkonsult. Vi ser fram emot din kontakt!

Om Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer att vara anställd av oss och uthyrd för att utföra sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter som biståndshandläggare inom äldreomsorgen. Du ansvarar för att utreda, bedöma behov och fatta beslut om bistånd för personer som är 65 år och äldre, främst enligt SoL. Även uppföljning av insatser ör en del av arbetet. Arbetet kräver lyhördhet för de äldres behov och innebär nära samarbete med vår uppdragsgivarens anställda. Du har dagligt stöd av en arbetsledare och en förste biståndshandläggare.

Vi erbjuder

Du kommer att vara anställd av Socionomera Bemanning AB. Som konsult hos oss erbjuds du goda och flexibla arbetsvillkor samt tydlighet kring vad som förväntas av dig. Vi månar om att du ska trivas och må bra i rollen som socionomkonsult och vi söker alltid långa samarbeten och relationer.

Vi kan bland annat erbjuda dig:

    Schyssta anställningsvillkor enligt vårt kollektivavtal med Akademikerförbunden
    En lön som du förtjänar och en transparent lönepolicy
    Tjänstepension genom Collectum som anses ha ett av marknadens bästa pensionslösningar
    Försäkringar som grupplivsförsäkring och sjukförsäkring via Fora
    Introduktion och regelbunden arbetsmiljöuppföljning
    Intern och extern handledning
    Friskvårdspeng och fortbildningspeng
    Stöd av konsultchefer som själva är socionomer
    Snabb och smidig personlig service
    En arbetsgivare som lägger stort fokus på hållbart och etiskt agerande inom socionombemanning

Ansökan

Du är varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan till oss. Vill du hellre börja med att höra mer så är du välkommen att kontakta oss via kontakt@socionomera.se eller 040-300 352.

Vi har fler än 100 ramavtal, som för dig innebär ett brett urval av intressanta uppdrag. Vi är vana problemlösare och vi kan erbjuda stöttning utifrån dina behov under hela uppdragsperioden.

Om oss

Socionomera Bemanning AB är ett auktoriserat bemanningsbolag och vi är specialiserade på uthyrning av socionomer. Vi är övertygade om att så gott som alla som väljer att arbeta med ett människovårdande yrke har omtanke om sina medmänniskor som främsta anledning. Vi vill göra allt vi kan för att underlätta för organisationer och personer som väljer att bry dig.

un ASSISTANT CONDUCTEUR DE TRAVAUX TP - VRD H/F
CDI, Amiens

L'entreprise
Leader mondial des sols sportifs de haute technicité, filiale d'un groupe international, notre client allie expertise technique, innovation et engagement environnemental pour créer des équipements sportifs reconnus pour leur qualité et leur performance.
Rejoindre ses équipes, c'est participer à des projets variés et ambitieux qui font vivre le sport au plus haut niveau.

Votre mission : concevoir les projets et accompagner leur réalisation sur le terrain
Ce poste polyvalent vous permet d'intervenir à toutes les étapes des projets, depuis leur conception jusqu'à leur livraison. Véritable trait d'union entre le bureau d'études et les équipes travaux, vous contribuez à la réussite technique, organisationnelle et opérationnelle des chantiers.
Selon les périodes de l'année et l'activité, vous partagez votre temps entre le bureau d'études et l'accompagnement des conducteurs de travaux sur le terrain.

Au bureau d'études :
- Réaliser les relevés de terrain et analyser les contraintes techniques des sites.
- Participer aux réponses aux appels d'offres et à la rédaction des mémoires techniques.
- Effectuer les chiffrages, les consultations fournisseurs et élaborer les plannings prévisionnels.
- Réaliser les plans techniques et les plans de marquage sous AutoCAD.
- Collaborer avec les équipes commerciales, les chargés d'affaires et les conducteurs de travaux afin de garantir la faisabilité des projets.
- Préparer les dossiers techniques nécessaires à la bonne exécution des chantiers.

Sur le terrain :
- Participer à l'organisation et à la coordination des travaux.
- Assurer le suivi des commandes, des approvisionnements et des livraisons.
- Accompagner et fédérer les équipes de chantier dans le respect des délais, de la qualité et des règles de sécurité.
- Veiller à la conformité des ouvrages et au respect des exigences techniques propres aux équipements sportifs.
- Participer aux réunions de chantier et assurer le lien avec les clients, maîtres d'œuvre et partenaires.
- Suivre l'avancement des travaux jusqu'à la réception des ouvrages et à la remise des dossiers de fin de chantier.

Profil recherché
De formation Bac+2 à Bac+3 dans le domaine des Travaux Publics, du Génie Civil ou des VRD (BTS TP, BUT Génie Civil, Licence Professionnelle ou équivalent), vous disposez idéalement d'une première expérience vous ayant permis de découvrir à la fois les études techniques et le suivi de chantier.

Vos qualités :
- Vous appréciez autant le travail de conception que la présence sur le terrain.
- Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'organisation et d'un réel sens du détail.
- Vous savez travailler en équipe et communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés.
- Vous êtes capable de gérer plusieurs sujets simultanément et de vous adapter aux imprévus.
- Vous maîtrisez AutoCAD 2D et êtes à l'aise avec la lecture de plans.
- Vous avez une bonne culture technique dans les domaines des TP, VRD ou aménagements extérieurs.
- Vous êtes mobile pour accompagner les chantiers sur plusieurs régions.

Au-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne curieuse, impliquée et polyvalente, souhaitant développer une expertise dans la réalisation d'équipements sportifs et intervenir aussi bien en préparation de projet qu'en accompagnement des travaux sur le terrain.

Ce que l'entreprise offre :
