jobs.title: Resort Manager / North Resort Oy
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme North Resort Oy:lle Pelloon Resort Manageria vastaamaan uuden resortin päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja liiketoiminnan kokonaisuudesta. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, ja valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan North Resort Oy:n palvelukseen.

North Resort Oy rakentaa Pellon Miekojärven rannalle uuden ympärivuotisen matkailuresortin, jossa yhdistyvät korkeatasoinen majoitus, laadukas ravintolatoiminta, henkilökohtainen palvelu ja aidot lappilaiset elämykset. Resortin toiminta käynnistyy marraskuussa 2026, ja ensimmäiset kansainväliset asiakkaat vastaanotetaan joulukuun alussa.

Tutustu yritykseen tarkemmin: https://www.northpremiumresort.com/

Resort Managerina

Työskentelet käytännönläheisessä johtotehtävässä, jossa yhdistyvät henkilöstön, asiakaskokemuksen, myynnin, talouden, turvallisuuden ja operatiivisen toiminnan johtaminen. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat:

* henkilöstön johtaminen, rekrytointi, perehdytys ja kehittäminen,
* asiakaskokemuksen ja palvelun laadun johtaminen,
* myynnin, käyttöasteen ja kaupallisen toiminnan kehittäminen,
* budjetointi, talouden seuranta ja kannattavuuden kehittäminen,
* varausjärjestelmien ja myyntikanavien kehittäminen sekä
* turvallisuuden, omavalvonnan ja vastuullisuuden varmistaminen.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Sales Managerin sekä muiden avainhenkilöiden ja sidosryhmien, kuten matkailukumppaneiden ja viranomaisten kanssa. Toimit esihenkilönä resortin eri toimintojen päälliköille ja raportoit yhtiön johdolle ja hallitukselle.

Tehtävä edellyttää

* kokemusta matkailu-, hotelli-, ravintola- tai palveluliiketoiminnan johtamisesta,
* vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja henkilöstöjohtamisesta,
* kaupallista ja taloudellista ymmärrystä,
* hyviä organisointi- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja,
* kykyä toimia itsenäisesti ja tehdä päätöksiä,
* kiinnostusta uuden liiketoiminnan rakentamiseen,
* sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa.

Parhaiten tehtävässä menestyy henkilö, jolla on aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä, esimerkiksi Resort Managerina tai Hotel Managerina. Meille koulutusta tärkeämpää on näyttö onnistuneesta kokonaisuuksien johtamisesta. North Resortin tiimiin sopii parhaiten oma-aloitteinen, käytännönläheinen ja vastuunkantokykyinen johtaja, joka viihtyy kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja innostuu uuden rakentamisesta.

Vastineeksi osaamisestasi tarjoamme

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden päästä rakentamaan uutta, korkeatasoista matkailukohdetta sen ensimmäisistä vaiheista lähtien ja vaikuttamaan merkittävästi resortin toimintamalleihin, prosesseihin ja työyhteisöön. Työskentelet kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa ja pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi uuden liiketoiminnan rakentamisessa. Tehtävän palkka on neuvoteltavissa huomioiden aiempi kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi. Tarvittaessa autamme myös asunnon järjestämisessä.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, jätä hakemuksesi pian nettisivuillamme olevan hakulomakkeen kautta tai kysy lisätietoja. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

Lisätietoja rekrytoinnista antaa: Jyri Soininen, p. 050 304 8650, jyri.soininen@osuma.fi

jobs.title: Head of Safety
jobs.description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?

If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as our Head of Safety at Esrange Space Center.

At Esrange Space Center, safety is fundamental to everything we do. Our operations include sounding rocket and balloon launches, rocket testing, and the development of orbital launch capabilities – activities that place high demands on safety, coordination and regulatory compliance.

As Head of Safety, you will lead and coordinate the overall safety work at Esrange Space Center. Your mission is to ensure a safe environment for employees, customers, contractors, visitors and the public across operations that include rocket and balloon launches, testing and future orbital launch activities.

You will set the frameworks and requirements for our safety work and lead experts within areas such as range safety, flight and campaign safety, occupational health and safety, fire protection and emergency preparedness. This is a strategic role with a strong operational focus, significant decision-making authority, and close collaboration with internal teams, authorities, and local stakeholders.

REQUIREMENTS

    A relevant degree in engineering, safety, risk management, HSE or fire protection, or equivalent experience.
    At least five years of safety or HSE experience from a regulated industrial or operational environment.
    Experience leading specialists and coordinating safety across several functions.
    Experience developing and maintaining safety management systems.
    Strong knowledge of risk management, emergency preparedness, and regulatory compliance.
    Experience working with authorities, permits, and external stakeholders.
    Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

Experience from aviation, airports, aerospace, defence or another safety-critical field is highly valued. Knowledge of flight safety, airspace coordination, Seveso, explosive materials, ADR, or systematic fire protection is an advantage.

You are an analytical and confident leader who remains calm under pressure. You combine structure and integrity with a practical approach and are comfortable making difficult decisions when safety is at stake. You also know how to build trust, challenge unsafe practices, and turn requirements into effective action.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    Lead and develop the overall safety function and Safety Management System at Esrange.
    Ensure clear safety frameworks, processes, and responsibilities.
    Coordinate the Esrange Safety Board and safety preparations for launches, tests and campaigns.
    Lead and coordinate safety specialists across range safety, flight safety, fire protection and emergency preparedness.
    Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, permits and authority requirements.
    Develop the site-wide crisis and emergency response organization, including training and exercises.
    Coordinate airspace, impact-area and public-safety matters with authorities and external stakeholders.
    Oversee incident management, safety planning, budgeting and continuous improvement.

WE OFFER YOU

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.



LOCATION

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center outside of Kiruna.

  

NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

This position is security-sensitive and requires approved security vetting and background check in accordance with the protective security act. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.

WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

jobs.title: Piping Team Leader
jobs.description:
Gemkom Engineering and Machinery Filial is a newly established branch of the Turkish company Gemkom. It is a leading engineering and manufacturing company that operates in a number of areas and in various ways within the steel industry.

We are participating in a project where Stegra AB establishes a steel mill in Norra Svartbyn in Boden where steel will be produced through an almost fossil-free process using hydrogen gas. Our mission is, among other things, to install machines used in steel production and includes work in mechanics, electronics and plumbing.

We now want to employ Piping Team Leaders. The work tasks may include but are not limited to:

Job Description

The Piping Team Leader is responsible for supervising and coordinating all piping installation and maintenance activities on site. This role involves leading a team of piping fitters and related personnel to ensure piping systems are installed, assembled, and maintained according to engineering drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations. The Piping Team Leader ensures work is completed efficiently, safely, and within project timelines.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead and supervise piping crews, including piping fitters and support personnel, during installation and maintenance activities.

· Review and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, piping isometrics, and technical specifications.

· Plan, organize, and assign daily work activities to ensure project schedules and deadlines are met.

· Oversee installation, alignment, and assembly of piping systems, valves, pumps, and associated equipment.

· Ensure proper pipe routing, supports, fittings, and installation methods in accordance with engineering requirements.

· Monitor work progress and ensure high standards of quality and workmanship.

· Coordinate with welding teams, mechanical crews, engineers, and supervisors to ensure smooth project execution.

· Conduct routine inspections of piping installations and ensure compliance with project specifications and industry standards.

· Ensure all work activities comply with company safety policies, site safety procedures, and regulatory requirements.

· Identify and resolve technical or installation issues that arise during project execution.

· Maintain records of work progress, manpower utilization, and materials usage.

· Provide technical guidance, training, and support to piping crew members when necessary.

Qualifications

· Experience in piping installation and maintenance in industrial, construction, or plant environments is preferred.

· Experience as a Piping Fitter or similar role, with leadership or supervisory experience preferred.

· Strong ability to read and interpret piping drawings, isometric drawings, and technical documentation.

· Knowledge of piping materials, fittings, valves, installation techniques, and industry standards.

· Understanding of safety procedures and construction site practices.

Skills and Competencies

· Leadership and team management skills

· Strong technical knowledge of piping systems

· Planning and organizational ability

· Problem-solving and decision-making skills

· Strong communication and coordination skills

· Commitment to quality and safety standards

jobs.title: Senior Innovation Consultant - EU Projects
jobs.description:
Job summary (Short promotional text)

We are looking for a Senior Consultant to strengthen our European Grants team in France.

You will advise innovative companies and organisations on European funding strategies and lead the development of complex grant applications for major R&D, industrial and innovation projects.

The role combines strategic consulting, project analysis, proposal writing and client management. We are looking for someone who can independently transform complex projects into compelling funding strategies and high quality European proposals.


Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below

Help ambitious organisations secure European funding for high impact innovation projects by combining strategic advice, technical understanding and excellent proposal development.


Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead the development of complex European funding applications under programmes such as Horizon Europe, Innovation Fund, LIFE and CEF.
  • Assess R&D and innovation projects, identify the most appropriate funding opportunities and advise clients on funding strategy.
  • Structure compelling project narratives covering excellence, innovation, impact, implementation and European added value.
  • Interview senior client stakeholders, scientists, engineers and technical experts to extract and challenge the information required for successful proposals.


Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Coordinate the complete proposal development process, including work plans, consortium inputs, budgets, deadlines and quality reviews.
  • Manage client relationships independently and act as a trusted advisor throughout the funding process.
  • Review and improve proposals prepared by other consultants and contribute to internal quality standards and methodologies.
  • Support the development of junior consultants and contribute to business development and the growth of PNO Innovation’s European Grants activities in France.


Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a scientific, engineering, technical, economic or innovation related discipline.
  • Several years of relevant experience in European funding, innovation consulting, R&D project development or a closely related environment.
  • Proven experience with European funding programmes, ideally including Horizon Europe and/or other major programmes such as Innovation Fund, LIFE or CEF. Demonstrated experience writing or leading high quality grant proposals.
  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.


Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Strong ability to understand complex scientific, technological and business concepts and turn them into persuasive narratives.
  • Strong client management, communication and project management skills.
  • Autonomous, rigorous and comfortable managing complex assignments under demanding deadlines.
  • Ability to mentor less experienced consultants and contribute to the development of the team.


Why us? (What do we offer) 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead major European funding projects with innovative companies and organisations.
  • Work across technologies, sectors and European programmes rather than being limited to a single funding instrument.
  • Join one of Europe’s largest specialist innovation and funding consultancies.
  • Work with an international network of more than 600 colleagues and European funding specialists.


Why us? (What do we offer) 2nd part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Take ownership of client relationships and complex strategic assignments.
  • Contribute to developing junior consultants and strengthening our European Grants practice in France.
  • Benefit from clear opportunities for professional development and increasing responsibility.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package according to experience and seniority.

jobs.title: Program Controller to premium EV brand!
jobs.description:
Are you an analytical controller with a passion for the automotive industry and product lifecycles? Do you thrive in cross-functional, international environments where your financial insights directly shape key strategic decisions? Then this might be your next opportunity!

About the position

Perido is looking for a Program Controller to join our client, a leading global premium EV brand. This positions is located in Gothenburg.

In this role, you will hold a key position supporting the development and financial steering of vehicle programs throughout key program milestones. You will work closely with Program Management and cross-functional stakeholders—including R&D, Manufacturing, Design, Procurement, Business Office, Volume Planning, and Finance—to ensure financial transparency and drive efficient program execution. The position uniquely combines program controlling across the full product lifecycle with financial controlling within a major automotive group, covering joint venture production and strategic sister-brand operations. providing broad exposure to both program and product cost controlling. You will also engage in close cooperation with international counterparts.

Your daily tasks

    Drive and communicate the financial progression of model year programs against established targets and milestones
    Serve as a key financial partner to program management, providing quality-assured financial data to support decision-making throughout the program lifecycle
    Act as the primary contact for program-related financial matters, both within Finance and towards operational stakeholders
    Secure, analyze, and deliver investment (CAPEX), cost, and profitability data for program milestones, including clear explanations of variances and underlying business drivers
    Actively participate in all financial planning processes, including Forecasts, Budget, and Business Planning (BPL), covering investment spend and vehicle profitability
    Lead financial controlling activities for manufacturing plants, ensuring robust reporting, analyses, and financial performance assessments aligned with business realities
    Perform financial analyses of transfer prices from manufacturing plants in close collaboration with transfer pricing controllers
    Drive and support business case development and investigations related to manufacturing operations, including Bill of Material (BOM) development, cost improvement initiatives, and cost reduction tracking

Your characteristics

To succeed in this role, you possess a strong analytical mindset and the ability to translate complex financial information into actionable business insights. You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional, and international environment, balancing strategic financial planning with operational business support. As a person, you are self-motivated, driven, and proactive when it comes to solving issues and suggesting improvements. You possess excellent communication skills and have a proven ability to build strong working relationships with multiple stakeholders.

Does this sound like an exciting challenge for you? We look forward to receiving your application—apply today!

Qualifications:

    Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent academic background
    3–10 years of experience in financial controlling or analyst roles, including experience setting and following up targets
    Outstanding analytical capabilities
    Very strong skills in Excel and complex data handling
    Strong project management skills, acting as the key link and center for inputs from numerous internal stakeholders
    Excellent communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

Meritorious:

    Understanding of potential cost and revenue drivers within the automotive industry
    Experience with product cost structures, BOM development, or transfer pricing

Contract type and hours

Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-02-28. Start 2026-10-01.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations.

Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

Responsible recruiter: charlotte.crowley@perido.se

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36008 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

jobs.title: PhD fellowship in Artificial Intelligence for Monitoring and Decision Support at Animal and Herd Level
jobs.description:
Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are offering a PhD fellowship in Artificial Intelligence for Monitoring and Decision Support at Animal and Herd Level commencing 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible hereafter.

Our group and research
The hired PhD student will join the research group Data & Modelling which currently has 9 members, including one research assistant, two PhD students, and 6 associate professors. Our research group is focused advanced methods for monitoring and modelling data from animal production systems. This includes the use of Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods.

Project description
The PhD project will be focused on developing, assessing, and comparing traditional and modern ML and AI methods in terms of their utility and practicality for monitoring diverse types of time series data recorded at the levels of herds, groups of animals, and individual animals. The project will be based on already available data sets, and the collection of new data is not expected to be a part of this project.

The data sets will include

  • Herd level input and production data with the aims of estimating e.g. infection status or environmental impact
  • Sensor data record on or around individuals or groups of animals with the aim of classifying health status or behaviour patterns
  • Video data recorded of individuals or groups of animals with the aim of classifying health status or behaviour patterns
The ML/AI methods will include

  • Traditional time series modelling, specifically dynamic linear models (a type of state space model)
  • Neural network-based time series models, specifically transformers
  • Convolutional neural networks, for encoding video frames
  • Closed frontier large language models (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini)
  • Small open weights models to be run locally (e.g. Qwen3.5-9B, OpenAI gpt-oss-20b, Mistral Ministral 3 8B Reasoning)
The exact combinations of data sets and methods will depend on the specific project formulated by the applicant during an initial three-month employment as a research assistant.

Principal supervisor is Associate professor Dan Børge Jensen, Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, daj@sund.ku.dk, Direct Phone: +4535333021.

Duration: 3 years as a PhD student + 3 months as research assistant for enrolment


Job description
Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:

  • Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.
  • Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points.
  • Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team.
  • Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project
  • Teaching and disseminating your knowledge.
  • Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project
PhD Programme Description:
The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., Anima Science).

Qualifications:
If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).

If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.

As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.

The successful candidate should further be able to demonstrate the following:

  • Mastery of the R language for statistical computing
  • Practical experience with the Keras and Tensorflow R packages
  • Practical experience with state space models (e.g. dynamic linear models) for time series modelling
  • Practical experience with training and evaluating fully connected artificial neural networks
  • Practical experience with training and evaluating convolutional neural networks
  • Practical experience with training and evaluating transformer neural networks
  • Practical experience with the use of large language models via API calls
Other important criteria are:

  • The grade point average achieved
  • Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project
  • Previous publications
  • Relevant work experience
  • Other professional activities
  • A curious mind-set with a strong interest in machine learning and artificial intelligence.
  • Language skills
Place of employment

The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and modern computer hardware for training artificial neural networks.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant during an initial three-month employment as a research assistant.

The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree.

Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 27,800 DKK/Roughly 3,700 EUR (October 2021 level) plus pension.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

Questions
For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website: https://healthsciences.ku.dk/phd/guidelines/

Application procedure
Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format:

1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)

2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

3. Certified copy of original Master of Science diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD fellowship employment, your master’s degree must be equivalent to a Danish master’s degree. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database: https://ufm.dk/en/education/recognition-and-transparency/find-assessments/assessment-database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science

4. Publication list (if possible)

Application deadline: 7 October 2026, 23.59pm CEST.

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.

The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.

Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

You find information about the recruitment process at: http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Interviews are expected to be held in week 45 or 46.

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. jobs.title: Udlejningsmægler i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Er du vores næste udlejningsmægler i Aarhus?

 Der er travlt hos Lejeboligmægleren, og vi søger derfor endnu en dygtig udlejningsmægler til vores afdeling i Aarhus.

 Lejeboligmægleren er en landsdækkende virksomhed med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Odense og Aalborg. Vi er specialiseret i udlejning af boliger og samarbejder med både professionelle ejendomsinvestorer, ejendomsselskaber og private udlejere om alt fra enkeltstående boliger til større projektbyggerier.

 Vi er bindeleddet mellem udlejer og lejer og arbejder hver dag for at sikre en professionel og effektiv udlejning samt den gode oplevelse for begge parter.

 Vi er en virksomhed i vækst med ambitionen om at være den største og foretrukne lejeboligmægler i Danmark – og vi søger nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være med på rejsen.

 Hos os får du blandt andet:

·         En flad organisation, hvor der ikke er langt mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

·         En ung arbejdsplads med højt tempo og stærkt socialt sammenhold.

·         Daglige sparringsmøder på tværs af afdelinger.

·         Fleksible arbejdsdage og stor grad af frihed under ansvar.

·         Sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviteter på tværs af virksomheden.

·         En lønpakke med fast løn og provision.

  Om jobbet

Som udlejningsmægler bliver din primære opgave at udleje vores kunders boliger og sikre det rette match mellem bolig og lejer.

 Du får en alsidig hverdag med mange boliger og kundehenvendelser i gang på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og samtidig sikrer en professionel og personlig service over for både lejere og udlejere.

 Du bliver en del af et ungt og energisk team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og gode resultater er i fokus. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, men du får samtidig stor frihed og ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

 Stillingen er på fuld tid og er som udgangspunkt et barselsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. Der vil være weekendarbejde, som på nuværende tidspunkt er hver 3. weekend.

 Det er et krav, at du har kørekort, da en stor del af arbejdsdagen foregår ude på fremvisninger. Når du ikke er på farten, har du din daglige base på vores kontor på Trindsøvej i Aarhus.

 Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·         Fremvisninger og udlejning af boliger.

·         Kommunikation og koordinering med nuværende og potentielle lejere.

·         Besvare henvendelser via diverse platforme og telefon.

 Dine kvalifikationer

For at trives i rollen som udlejningsmægler er det vigtigt, at du har fokus på service, stærk kommunikation og en positiv indstilling. Du skal også have kendskab til Aarhus og omegn samt være i stand til at kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk.

Erfaring fra ejendomsbranchen, salg eller kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For os er din personlighed, dit drive og din tilgang til kunderne mindst lige så vigtig.

Derudover skal du være:

·         Serviceminded

·         Struktureret og god til at organisere

·         Udadvendt og trives i en kundekontaktrolle

·         Samarbejdsvillig og en holdspiller

·         Energisk, positiv og klar til nye udfordringer

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Er du vores nye udlejningsmægler? Send din ansøgning til job@lejeboligmaegleren.dk med emnet "Udlejningsmægler, Aarhus". Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at fjerne opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og CV.

Har du spørgsmål?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller os, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores afdelingsdirektør Niels Juul Jørgensen på tlf. 4040 2489 eller mail nju@lejeboligmaegleren.dk.

jobs.title: Sjukepleiar, 2 x i inntil 100% fast - bonus og løn over tariff
jobs.employer: GULEN KOMMUNE SONE BREKKE, DALSØYRA, BYRKNES
jobs.description:
Om stillinga 

Gulen kommune har ledig to i inntil 100% faste stillingar som sjukepleiar ved Sone Brekke, Byrknes og Dalsøyra (Sone BBD) frå snarast/etter avtale. Desse stillingane er for tida knytt til rullerande todelt turnus på 12 veker i Brekke. Den eine faste stillinga har arbeid med langvakter 4. kvar helg og ordinære vakter i vekedagane. Den andre faste stillinga har langvakter kvar 4. helg og kombinasjon av langvakter og ordinære vakter i vekedagane. 

Ta kontakt med kontaktperson i annonsen dersom du har spørsmål til stillingane/turnus. 

Sone BBD har ansvar for heimetenestene i områda Brekke, Byrknes og Dalsøyra. 

Me tilbyr

  • Spanande stillingar i ei teneste i utvikling. Rom for å kunne bidra aktivt i utviklingsarbeidet  
  • Bonusordning på 100 000kr (i 100% stilling) ved binding i 2 år i desse stillingane. Bonus vert som hovudregel betalt ut på slutten av bindingstida, om ikkje anna vert avtalt
  • Løn over tariff for sjukepleiarar i turnus
  • Ekstra helgekompensasjon ved gått vakt 
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar

Arbeidsoppgåver 
  • Sjukepleiefagleg ansvar og oppgåver
  • Pasientretta oppgåver, som til dømes pleie og oppfølging av brukarane
  • Samarbeid med andre faggrupper, 2. linjeteneste m.fl.
  • Andre oppgåver som måtte kome til

I sone BBD arbeider det både nyutdanna og tilsette med lang erfaring. Det er eit tett og godt samarbeid mellom assistentar, fagarbeidarar og sjukepleiarar/vernepleiarar kvar dag. Samarbeidet er viktig for at tenestene våre skal verte best mogleg for innbyggjarane i Gulen kommune, og noko me har fokus på kontinuerleg


Kvalifikasjonskrav 
  • Autorisasjon som sjukepleiar
  • Gode norskkunnskapar - både munnleg og skriftleg
  • Gyldig politiattest 
  • Førarkort klasse B

Personlege eigenskapar 
  • Er fleksibel og kommuniserer/samhandlar godt med brukarar/pårørande og kollegaer
  • Vert motivert av å yte gode tenester til brukarane, og kan vere med å gje dei ein stabil og god kvardag
  • Kan bidra til eit godt arbeidsmiljø og har fokus på kvalitet og faglig utvikling
  • Tar initiativ, er strukturert, fleksibel og har gode samarbeidsevner
  • Å vere personleg eigna kan verte vektlagt ved tilsetjing

Anna 
  • Tenestespråket i Gulen kommune er nynorsk
  • Tilsetjing etter gjeldande lover, føresegner og avtalar 
  • For tilsetjing innan pleie og omsorg, miljøteneste, barnevern, i skule, SFO og i barnehage, vert det stilt krav om politiattest etter aktuell/gjeldande lovheimel før oppstart i stillinga. Det skal berre krevjast politiattest av den som får tilbod om stillinga
  • Vi gjer merksam på at søkjarlister med namn, kjønn, alder og noverande stilling er offentleg informasjon. Dersom søkjarar likevel ber om konfidensiell handsaming, og grunnen for å unnta offentleggjering ikkje vert godkjent, får søkjaren høve til å trekke søknaden sin før offentleggjering

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gulen kommune ligg vakkert til ved innløpet til Sognefjorden. Kommunen består av både fjell- og kystlandskap, med 1500 øyer, holmar og skjær, som innbyr til eit aktivt friluftsliv både på land og ved sjøen.

Kommunen har 2301 innbyggjarar, ledige barnehageplassar, og er eit godt oppvekstmiljø for barn og unge. Sjå Gulen kommune for meir informasjon.

jobs.title: Automekaanikko
jobs.description:
Etsimme automekaanikkoa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Kaarinaan! Asiakasyrityksemme on jo pitkään toiminut alalla ja he tarjoavat monipuolisesti palveluitaan liittyen ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjauspalveluihin.

Tehtävässä keskityt tekemään ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustehtäviä, on sitten kyseessä avustavat tai haastavemmat tehtävät. Työpäiviisi voi sisältyä esim. lisävarusteasennuksia, vikojen etsintää, sähköistyksiä, moottorin korjauksia, vaihteistotöitä, jarrutöitä tai sitten yksinkertaisempia määräaikaishuoltoja kuten öljyjen ja suodattimien vaihdot sekä paljon muuta. Töitä tehdään asiakasyrityksen toimipisteellä ma-pe ja 37,5h/viikko.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- B-ajokorttia ja SFS 6002 sähkötyöturvallisuuskorttia.

\- Olet suorittanut vähintään ajoneuvoalan perustutkinnon ja sinulla on jo jonkin verran aikaisempaa työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä.

\- Ford on merkkinä sinulle entuudestaan tuttu ja mahdollisesti MB sekä VAG-konsernikin.

\- Tehtävään saa normaalin perehdytyksen, mutta odotamme sinulta kyvykkyyttä oppia ja omaksua uusia asioita nopeasti sekä omatoimisuutta.

\- Tärkeänä pidämme myös kykyä sitoutua työhön, pitkäjänteisyyttä, ongelmanratkaisu- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja, kädentaitoja, joustavuutta sekä itsenäistä, rehtiä ja ammattimaista työskentelyotetta.

Paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan. Täytä hakemuksesi ohessa olevan linkin kautta ja kerro siinä mahdollisimman kattavasti itsestäsi, osaamisestasi sekä aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. jobs.title: Gryning söker enhetschef till Bergiusgården i Ljungskile
jobs.description:
Ägs av kommuner – drivs av engagemang! I 25år har Gryning erbjudit HVB- och öppenvård för barn, ungdomar och familjer, jour- och familjehem, beroendevård, lägenheter med stöd, insatser mot hedersrelaterat våld och förtryck samt LSS-boende. Vi erbjuder rådgivning och utbildning samt hjälper till med placeringar. Gryning ägs av kommunerna i Västra Götaland via de fyra kommunalförbunden.

Bergiusgården tar emot ungdomar mellan 16-21 år med missbruksproblematik, där vi erbjuder heldygnsomsorg och kvalificerad behandling. Ungdomarna placeras enligt SOL eller LVU. Vår huvuduppgift är att tillsammans med ungdomen och hens nätverk möjliggöra ett förändringsarbete i en trygg och stabil miljö där vi strävar efter att bidra till förändrade, förbättrade och varaktiga livsvillkor för den unge.

Vi söker nu dig som enhetschef som tillsammans med Gryning vill utveckla verksamheten på Bergius!

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vad innebär tjänsten?

Verksamheten vilar på ett miljöterapeutiskt förhållningssätt där struktur och relation är centrala delar. Vi arbetar med lågaffektivt bemötande, där MI genomsyrar både samtal och vardagligt förhållningssätt och vi utgår från traumamedveten omsorg i allt vi gör. Som enhetschef för Bergiusgården har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamhetens kvalitet, ekonomi, personal och arbetsmiljö. Du leder, planerar och följer upp verksamheten med fokus på hög kvalitet och hållbara arbetssätt.

I rollen ingår även ansvar för kundkontakter, samverkan med uppdragsgivare och myndigheter samt arbete med verksamhets- och metodutveckling. Du har många både interna och externa kontaktytor och samverkar nära kollegor inom Gryning.

Tjänsten ger dig chans att påverka både struktur, kultur och arbetssätt.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vem är du?

Du är en trygg, tydlig och engagerande ledare med förmåga att skapa delaktighet och driva verksamheten mot uppsatta mål. Du arbetar strukturerat, har god planeringsförmåga och är van att följa upp och utveckla verksamhet och medarbetare. Ditt ledarskap präglas av lyhördhet, lösningsfokus och ett genuint engagemang för både personal och målgrupp.

Du har akademisk examen, exempelvis som socionom, socialpedagog, beteendevetare eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Då du som enhetschef ansvarar för verksamhetens tillstånd behöver du uppfylla IVO:s krav på relevant högskoleutbildning samt erfarenhet från liknande verksamhet. Det är meriterande om du har arbetslivserfarenhet av aktuell målgrupp.

Du har god samarbetsförmåga, är kommunikativ och har förmågan att inspirera till engagemang och ansvarstagande. Tjänsten innebär resor och kräver därför körkort. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Vi erbjuder

jobs.title: Sjuksköterska till geriatriken i Bromma
jobs.description:
Geriatriken på Stockholms Sjukhem är en av de största geriatriska klinikerna i regionen med drygt 370 anställda medarbetare och drygt 7000 vårdtillfällen per år. Verksamheten erbjuder akutgeriatrisk vård och rehabilitering med intag dygnet runt och bedriver även kognitiv mottagning. Vården bedrivs i multiprofessionella team i nära samarbete mellan personal, patient och närstående. Hos oss är delaktighet, utveckling och kvalité fokusområden.

Din roll som sjuksköterskaI samarbete med undersköterskor, läkare och paramedicinska yrkesgrupper ansvarar du för att utföra både basal och specifik omvårdnad, förebygga risker och hantera akuta situationer. I ditt arbete möter du allmängeriatriska patienter med olika diagnoser så som frakturer, stroke och/eller infektioner. Du har alltid nära stöd i dina kollegor och chef men arbetets art bygger på att du ska kunna fatta egna beslut och agera självständigt om situationen kräver, då du som sjuksköterska leder arbetet på avdelningen.

Hos oss får du

    en gedigen introduktion
    en familjär, positiv och inkluderande arbetsplats där vi lär av varandra
    kompetensutveckling med tillgång till interna och externa utbildningar
    en närvarande, lyhörd och engagerad chef
    ett grymt-roligt och professionellt team!

Är du vår nya kollega?

Krav för tjänsten är att du är legitimerad sjuksköterska, gärna med erfarenhet av sjukvård och gärna geriatrisk vård, samt har goda kunskaper i svenska tal och skrift. Stor vikt läggs vid personliga egenskaper och vi söker dig som:

    är trygg och självständig i din profession
    trivs med den variation som arbetet erbjuder i kombination med att du är lösningsorienterad i din natur
    har ett mjukt och respektfullt bemötande samt har en förmåga att på ett naturligt sätt etablera en god relation till patient och närstående

Låter detta som du? Då kommer du att trivas med oss och vi med dig! Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

Om tjänsten och ansökan

Tjänsten är heltid dag, tillsvidare. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och 6 månaders provanställning.

Urvalet hanteras löpande. Har du ytterligare frågor om tjänsten besvaras de av enhetschef geraitrik joanna.grauers@stockholmssjukhem.se eller Maryam Kahurzadeh, maryam.kahurzadeh@stockholmssjukhem.se.

Vi arbetar för en trygg och säker hälso- och sjukvård. Därför genomför vi bakgrundskontroller som en del i vår rekryteringsprocess och innan anställning. Kontrollerna kan variera beroende på roll. På vår informationssida kan du läsa mer om vilka kontroller som ingår.

Stockholms Sjukhem arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens för att främja att vi är en arbetsplats för alla.  Vi har tagit ställning till annonsering, vilket gör att vi inte önskar säljsamtal för ytterligare frågor kring annonsering, rekrytering eller bemanning.

Stockholms Sjukhem är en av Sveriges största idéburna vårdgivare. Vi erbjuder ett brett vårdutbud inom geriatrik, rehabilitering, palliativ vård och äldreomsorg. Att bedriva sjukvård och äldreomsorg är ett stort samhällsansvar och som godkänd universitetssjukvårdsenhet arbetar vi ständigt med forskning, utveckling och utbildning. Hos oss arbetar du i en varm miljö som värdesätter det personliga bemötandet och kännetecknas av värdeorden engagemang, kunskap och omtanke.

jobs.title: Senior Automation  Engineer -SCADA
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Automation Engineer SCADA

About the Role: We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Senior Automation Engineer SCADA to ensure the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of our SCADA networks and Substation Automation Systems (SAS). The ideal candidate will be a technical expert capable of leading projects from bay to entire substation SAS/SCADA design and commissioning.

Key Responsibilities & Core Requirements:

    HVAC Substation Automation: Core Knowledge and Hands-on experience in HVAC Substation Automation.
    System & Network Mastery: Extensive SCADA, RTU, PLC, Networking, and Protocol expertise. Familiarity with multi-vendor systems (such as ABB RTU, Schneider PACiS, or MicroSCADA) and PLC programming is highly valued.
    Design & Commissioning: Hands-on experience in design and commissioning of HVAC Substations (specifically 66/132kV). This must include IED Communication configuration, signal testing, SCADA Configuration, Data concentrator configuration, along with Protocol conversion knowledge and hands-on experience.
    Process & Risk Management: Able to follow the process, identify gaps and risks, and propose solution recommendations to ensure the operational integrity of our SAS/SCADA systems remains optimal.
    Protocol Proficiency: Competence in configuring and troubleshooting standard industry protocols, including IEC61850, IEC60870-5-101, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, and Modbus.
    Testing & Execution: Preparation of signal lists, commissioning reports, and active participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
    Cybersecurity & Networking: Enforcement of cybersecurity adherence, user profile management on SAS systems, and configuration of Ethernet switches, VLANs, and network redundancy.
    Why Join Us? As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will provide expert advice on SAS/SCADA best trends, taking on a crucial role in project scoping, supervision, and the management of major SCADA project works. If you have a proven track record of maintaining conducive operational environments and delivering high-quality automation engineering solutions, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Produktionstekniker - FLIR!
jobs.description:
Gillar du att skruva, justera och lösa problem när en maskin inte beter sig som den ska? Då kan det här vara rätt nästa steg för dig.

WeStaff Sweden söker nu en tekniskt nyfiken och praktiskt lagd person till FLIR i Täby. Här får du en vardag där du är nära maskinerna, produktionen och människorna som arbetar med dem.

Det här är en roll för dig som hellre tar fram verktygslådan än sitter still framför ett skrivbord. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, det viktiga är att du tycker om teknik, vill förstå hur saker fungerar och gillar att hitta lösningar.

Om FLIR

På FLIR i Täby tillverkas avancerade optiska komponenter som används i bland annat värmekameror och andra produkter inom avancerad sensorteknik.

Som Produktionstekniker blir du en del av den dagliga produktionen och arbetar med utrustningen som gör tillverkningen möjlig. Ena stunden kan du behöva undersöka varför en maskin stannat, nästa stund justera en komponent eller hjälpa en operatör att få igång utrustningen igen.

En stor del av rollen handlar om att vara nyfiken och metodisk: Vad har hänt? Varför händer det? Vad behöver justeras eller åtgärdas för att maskinen ska fungera igen?

Du arbetar både med planerat underhåll och med problem som behöver lösas här och nu. Samtidigt får du möjlighet att lära dig mer om avancerade maskiner och processer inom precisionsproduktion.

En vardag nära tekniken

I rollen kommer du bland annat att arbeta med:

    

Felsökning när produktionsutrustning inte fungerar som den ska

    

Förebyggande underhåll och enklare service

    

Justering och byte av mekaniska komponenter

    

Mekanik, pneumatik och enklare el

    

CNC-maskiner och annan precisionsutrustning

    

Slip-, poler- och rengöringsutrustning

    

Kontroller och funktionskontroller av maskiner

    

Dokumentation av underhåll och genomförda åtgärder

    

Installation och uppstart av ny utrustning

    

Förbättringar av maskiner, arbetssätt och processer

    

Teknisk support till operatörer och produktion

Du kommer alltså inte att göra samma sak varje dag. Rollen innebär variation och mycket kontakt med både utrustning och kollegor.

Vem tror vi att du är?

Vi tror att du kan ha många olika vägar in i rollen.

Kanske har du arbetat som industrimekaniker, underhållstekniker, servicetekniker, CNC-tekniker, maskinoperatör eller produktionstekniker. Kanske har du en teknisk utbildning och har upptäckt att det är när du får arbeta praktiskt som du trivs som bäst. Det vi framför allt letar efter är en person som:

    

Är praktiskt lagd och tycker om att arbeta med händerna

    

Har ett genuint tekniskt intresse

    

Gillar att felsöka och lösa problem

    

Har grundläggande kunskaper inom mekanik

    

Har erfarenhet av industri, produktion, service eller underhåll

    

Är bekväm med att använda verktyg och teknisk utrustning

    

Kan läsa och förstå tekniska instruktioner och enklare ritningar

    

Har grundläggande datorvana

    

Behärskar svenska och engelska

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet från optikbranschen. Har du arbetat med CNC, finmekanik, precisionsmaskiner, medicinteknik eller annan tekniskt avancerad produktion är det ett stort plus, men det är din tekniska förståelse och vilja att lära som väger tyngst.

Vi erbjuder dig

    

Ett spännande uppdrag hos ett innovativt teknikföretag

    

Möjlighet att arbeta med avancerad optik- och sensorteknik

    

En modern arbetsmiljö med hög teknisk kompetens

    

Möjlighet att utvecklas inom underhåll och maskinteknik

    

Goda möjligheter till ett långsiktigt uppdrag för rätt person

    

Anställning hos WeStaff Sweden med kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor

Praktisk information

Tjänst: Produktionstekniker Omfattning: Heltid Arbetstid: Dagtid, mån-fre Plats: Täby/Arninge Start: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse

Om WeStaff Sweden AB

WeStaff Sweden AB är ett växande konsult- och rekryteringsföretag inom Produktion & Tillverkning. Våra värderingar bygger på personlig relation, trygghet och långsiktighet.

Vi är ett kunskapsdrivet team med över 30 års samlad erfarenhet från branschen. Vårt arbete kännetecknas av kvalitet, nytänkande och ett personligt engagemang. Läs mer om oss på www.westaff.se

Vill du bli en del av oss? Ansök redan idag och bli vår nästa medarbetare!

jobs.title: Director, Business Development Data Centers
jobs.description:
Company description:

NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world.

Job description:

Build early commercial partnerships across the data centre marketWould you like to shape how NKT engages with customers across the growing data centre segment? As Director, Business Development Data Centers, you will establish early commercial relationships, develop qualified opportunities and coordinate a OneNKT approach across business lines. This international role offers the opportunity to support NKT’s growth journey while contributing to the infrastructure needed for the green transition.

Develop strategic data centre opportunities across selected marketsYou will manage front-end business development across the data centre ecosystem, engaging customers and partners before formal tendering begins. By understanding customer priorities and coordinating internal stakeholders, you will help shape commercial positioning and prepare qualified opportunities for handover to the relevant business line. You will also contribute to NKT’s data centre go-to-market strategy and provide structured insights into market dynamics, customer needs, competitors and portfolio gaps.Your responsibility will be to:


    Map and prioritise target customers, projects and decision-makers
    Build relationships with developers, operators, EPC contractors, integrators and OEMs
    Develop and manage qualified opportunities through early customer engagement
    Coordinate customer activities across NKT business lines and functions
    Support partnership discussions, market analysis and management updates

The position may be based in London, Runcorn, Teesside, Cologne, Berlin, Malmö, Karlskrona or Copenhagen. Planned travel of more than 50 days per year is expected, including customer meetings, industry forums and partner discussions.

Profile description:

Commercial relationship builder with a collaborative working styleYou communicate clearly with people at different organisational levels and create trust through a consistent and considered approach. You are comfortable working across functions, balancing several stakeholder perspectives and maintaining structure as opportunities develop. Curiosity, sound judgement and an ability to translate discussions into practical next steps will help you work effectively in an international and matrix-based organisation.You also have:




    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics or a related field
    Experience in business development, strategic sales, key account management or go-to-market roles within electrical infrastructure, electrical components or power solutions
    Experience with complex solution selling
    Established network and experience within the data centre ecosystem, including developers, operators, EPC contractors, integrators or OEMs
    A record of developing senior external and internal relationships and early-stage commercial opportunities
    Fluent English



Connect data centre growth with the green transitionWe aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths, even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.



This role offers opportunities for professional development in a collaborative, international setting. You will expand your knowledge of the data centre value chain, work with colleagues across several business lines and develop your commercial and strategic capabilities. You will also contribute to NKT’s market approach within a growing infrastructure segment connected to the green transition.“As a leader, I believe in giving you the freedom to manage tasks while being available to support you when needed. I appreciate work-life balance and aim to build an environment that supports it", says Hiring Manager, Simone Pagliuca







Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!







We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 7th of October. Please submit your application in English. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests will be included in the recruitment process. For inquiries about the recruitment process, please reach out to Global Talent Attraction Specialist, Angelina Nilsson at Angelina.nilsson@nkt.com. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.



We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.



Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!

jobs.title: BMS Project Manager for Datacenter Projects
jobs.description:
We are recruiting experienced BMS Project Manager for datacenter projects in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites. You will work closely with project teams, subcontractors, consultants, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget.

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in high-profile critical infrastructure projects within a growing and technically demanding industry.

The assignment starts ASAP and is expected to continue for approximately 12 months.

The successful candidate can be employed under a fixed-term employment contract or engaged through a contractor agreement, depending on their situation and preferences.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites
* Manage project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and risk management plans
* Oversee project financials, including cost control, forecasting, reporting, and margin management
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and project requirements
* Coordinate activities with consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders
* Oversee procurement, logistics, and resource allocation across multiple sites
* Monitor project performance and provide regular project reporting
* Support commissioning, handover, and project close-out activities

What We Are Looking For:

* 5+ years of project management experience within construction, building services, automation, or related industries
* Demonstrated success managing complex, multidisciplinary projects
* Strong understanding of construction contracts, project controls, and safety legislation
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, and P&L responsibility
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Good written and spoken English communication skills
* Valid driving licence and willingness to travel between project sites within the Helsinki Metropolitan Area
* Valid right to work in Finland
* Valid Occupational Safety Card and Electrical Safety Card

Previous experience in datacenter construction projects will be considered a strong advantage. We also value building automation (BMS) knowledge and experience with platforms such as Metasys, EasyIO, Tridium Niagara, Trend, Siemens, Schneider Electric, or similar systems. Experience managing large-scale projects, working in regulated environments, and proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project or Primavera will further support success in this role.

PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certifications, as well as a degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Automation, or a related field, are considered advantageous.

Details:

The position is based in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area across multiple datacenter construction sites. The assignment starts ASAP and will last approximately 12 months.

Working hours are between Monday to Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm and Saturday from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm.

Interested?

Apply through the application link and submit your CV and salary expectations. A brief application letter is optional.

Apply as soon as possible, as interviews have already started and suitable candidates may be selected during the application period.

For data security reasons, we do not accept applications via email.

For further information, please contact:

Leevi Rantalainen, leevi.rantalainen@manpowergroup.fi, +358 40 480 2914
Miia Koivula, miia.koivula@manpowergroup.fi, +358 40 193 0347

With offices in 80 countries, Manpower is one of the largest contingent and permanent staffing firms globally, and the market leader in the Nordic and Baltic countries. In Finland we are one of the largest companies specializing in recruitment, temporary staffing and assessments. We help employers find competent and motivated professionals for interim and permanent positions at all organizational levels. We serve our clients and candidates across the nation.

jobs.description:
Het uitvoeren van industriële schilder‑ en oppervlaktebehandelingswerkzaamheden met als doel het duurzaam beschermen van industriële installaties, staalconstructies, machines, leidingen en opslagtanks tegen corrosie, chemicaliën, slijtage en overige invloeden. Dit gebeurt volgens geldende veiligheidsnormen, kwaliteitsrichtlijnen en projectspecificaties.

Verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Voorbereiden van oppervlakken door reinigen, ontvetten, schuren (manueel of machinaal) en stralen.
  • Aanbrengen van primers, laklagen, epoxy‑coatings, polyurethaan‑coatings en andere beschermsystemen.
  • Uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles zoals droge en natte laagdiktemetingen, visuele inspecties en hechtingscontroles, temperatuur- en luchtvochtigheidsmetingen en ruwheidsmetingen.
  • Correct instellen en bedienen van schilder-, straal‑ en spuitapparatuur.
  • Afdekken en beschermen van niet‑te‑behandelen zones.
  • Signaleren van afwijkingen, beschadigingen of corrosieproblemen en uitvoeren van herstelwerkzaamheden.
  • Registreren van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden en gebruikte materialen.
  • Werken volgens veiligheidsinstructies (VCA), inclusief correcte inzet van PBM’s.
  • Eventueel ondersteunen bij brandwerende, chemisch resistente of hygiënische coatings.
  • In teamverband samenwerken met (meewerkende) voormannen en inspecteurs.

Je hebt geen hoogtevrees en je bent een echte teamplayer. Je bent bereid om nieuwe zaken te leren zodat je op rustigere momenten multidisciplinair inzetbaar bent.
