jobs.description:
.

Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring cooks, servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleanliness, occupational health and safety, and general restaurant operating requirements. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

Cabinet cherche son Orthoptiste pour le cabinet de SAINT GEORGES DE DIDONNES
prise de poste immédiate
Sous la responsabilité de l'ophtalmologue , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le parcours de soins du patient. Vos missions principales seront :

Examens et explorations fonctionnelles : Réalisation des examens complémentaires (réfraction, tonométrie, OCT, champ visuel, topographie cornéenne, rétinographie, biométrie, etc.).
Bilan orthoptique : Évaluation des troubles visuels (motilité oculaire, vision binoculaire, troubles de l'accommodation, etc.) et analyse des besoins du patient.
Rééducation et réadaptation : Conception et mise en œuvre de programmes de soins personnalisés (prise en charge du strabisme, de l'amblyopie, de la fatigue visuelle liée aux écrans, ou accompagnement en basse vision).
Coordination : Participation à l'élaboration du projet de soins en collaboration avec l'équipe médicale et les autres professionnels de santé.
Suivi administratif : Gestion des dossiers patients et transmission des bilans aux médecins.

CDD de 6 mois renouvelable

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform (Foundations Lead)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Data Foundations team builds and operates the batch and streaming infrastructure behind our product features, analytics, search, and AI experiences. We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to shape the next generation of this platform as Notion serves larger customers, expands globally, and supports more data-intensive products. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems, set direction, build and develop a high-performing team, and lead multi-quarter initiatives across our data lake, streaming, distributed-compute, governance, and reliability systems. You’ll stay close to critical technical decisions while creating clear ownership, growing engineers and technical leaders, and helping the team execute as one—partnering closely with Data Engineering, Data Product, Search, AI, Infrastructure, and Security.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Set the direction for Data Foundations. Turn ambiguous company and customer needs into a clear multi-quarter strategy across the data lake, streaming, distributed compute, governance, and platform reliability—and align engineers and partner teams around it.

 - Build and develop a high-performing team. Attract strong engineers, set clear expectations, grow technical leaders, and create an environment of ownership, direct feedback, and accountability.

 - Lead the team’s hardest initiatives from idea to operation. Ensure complex work has strong technical ownership, de-risk architectures through prototypes, break work into shippable milestones, and coordinate execution across engineers and teams.

 - Make Notion’s data platform enterprise-ready. Guide the team toward durable foundations for external key management, data residency, access controls, lifecycle management, and governance without creating separate systems for every requirement.

 - Raise reliability, simplicity, and cost efficiency. Identify systemic risks and architectural gaps, establish clear service ownership, and lead migrations that make Kafka, Debezium, S3/Iceberg, Spark, EMR, Athena, and related systems easier to operate at scale.

 - Multiply the engineering organization. Establish reusable abstractions and paved paths, delegate meaningful ownership, raise the quality of technical decisions, and scale expertise through coaching, documentation, tooling, design reviews, and direct collaboration.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Deep data-platform expertise. You have designed and operated large-scale batch and streaming systems and can reason across storage, compute, ingestion, orchestration, serving, governance, and production operations.

 - Direction-setting leadership. You have led a Data Platform or infrastructure team through multi-quarter work—finding the right problems, defining a strategy, sequencing execution, and driving decisions with long-term consequences.

 - Team-building and talent development. You have attracted strong engineers, grown people across career stages, developed technical leaders, and created clarity when expectations or performance needed to change.

 - Hands-on engineering judgment. You stay close to critical systems and designs and know when to prototype, simplify, buy, build, or migrate. You can go deep while preserving ownership for the engineers leading the work.

 - Platform-product thinking. You understand the needs behind partner requests and turn repeated patterns into safe, ergonomic, self-serve capabilities rather than accumulating bespoke solutions.

 - Organizational influence. You create clarity across team boundaries, surface uncomfortable technical or organizational risks early, and help engineers do their best work through strong context, delegation, feedback, and coaching.

 - You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, move faster, and build more creatively.




THE SYSTEMS AND PROBLEMS YOU MAY LEAD

 - Evolving Notion’s data lake toward an S3 + Iceberg lakehouse with stronger governance, discoverability, schema evolution, and lifecycle controls

 - Scaling Kafka and Debezium-based streaming infrastructure that powers real-time product, analytics, and AI use cases

 - Improving Spark and distributed-compute performance, workload isolation, developer experience, and cost efficiency

 - Designing EKM, data residency, and compliant processing capabilities across Notion’s data estate

 - Creating clear platform interfaces and self-serve primitives for Data Engineering, Search, AI, and product teams




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Notion’s data infrastructure is no longer only an internal analytics layer. It increasingly powers customer-facing features, AI systems, enterprise controls, and high-volume product workflows. The team needs a leader who can see across these systems, build the technical leadership and operating culture required for that responsibility, and find the problems that matter before they become roadmap blockers. Success means Data Foundations has a strong, growing team with clear direction and dependable execution—and teams across Notion can build ambitious data-powered products faster without compromising customer trust.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $281,000 - $334,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer  (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements, 1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité - nous recherchons un**-**e Software Engineer senior aussi bien à l'aise avec Django que React pour nous aider à accélérer, se connecter à plus de fabricants et améliorer l'impact de l'application. Tu seras au cœur de son développement sur toutes les plateformes web/iOS/Android.
Chez Hello Watt, nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeur. Nous cherchons des ingénieurs enthousiastes à l'idée d'explorer et de définir, ensemble, les contours de ce que sera demain notre nouveau métier de développeur.
Tes missions :
- Implémenter de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android)

- Développer les intégrations api de pilotage d'appareil : onduleurs solaires, thermostats, bornes de recharge de véhicules électriques

- Intégrer des fonctionnalités de flexibilité énergétique et d'effacement (programmation intelligente, pilotage selon les signaux de production solaire/tension du réseau, etc.).

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes, des tests solides et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Contribuer activement à l'outillage et aux workflows IA de l'équipe : prompts et conventions partagés, garde-fous, quality gates et boucles de feedback pour améliorer en continu la qualité du code généré

- Concevoir l'évolution de l'architecture de la plateforme

Profil recherché
À l'ère où l'IA accélère la production de code, nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- System architecture : vision système, capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

- AI-native mindset : pratique avancée des outils d'IA pour le développement, esprit critique sur leurs sorties, et envie de contribuer à élever la pratique de toute l'équipe

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement web avec python (Django, Flask, Sanic, FastAPI.) et avec un framework javascript (React, Vue, Angular.)

- Au moins 5 années d'expérience dans un poste similaire, au sein d'un environnement de travail mettant l'expérience utilisateur au coeur des préoccupations

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, architecture modulaire par domaines métie

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Backend
- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)

- Orchestration de taches: Celery

- Cache : Redis

Frontend Web
- Language : TypeScript / JavaScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Styling : Design System Hello Watt + Tailwind CSS

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

- Partage de code : Réutilisation du code web en natif

Base de Données
- SQL : MySQL pour les données relationnelles

- NoSQL : MongoDB pour la gestion de données semi-structurées / documents

Infrastructure & Déploiement
- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)

- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisés

Outils & Collaboration
- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)

- Documentation : Slite

- Contrôle de version : GitLab

Tu as envie de travailler sur de multiples projets où les mises en production de tes travaux sont rapides ?
Tu veux intégrer une Greentech travaillant sur des produits à la pointe en Europe ?
Tu veux utiliser la data pour proposer des services permettant de réduire l'empreinte carbone et les factures d'énergie ?
Ne cherche plus, viens chez Hello Watt !
Nos valeurs :
- Impact more : nous accompagnons les particuliers dans la transition énergétique et nous utilisons la tech pour leur permettre de maîtriser leur consommation. Nous visons grand pour maximiser cet impact.

- User focused : à l'écoute de nos clients, nous cherchons à les étonner par la qualité de nos services et de nos produits.

- One caring team : nous veillons au bien être et au développement de chacun en fondant nos relations sur l'humilité et l'honnêteté.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:

C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement, réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité. Nous recherchons un Frontend Engineer, aussi à l'aise dans une application React web/TypeScript que dans une page server-rendered avec HTMX et AlpineJS, supporté par notre design system basé sur TailwindCSS.
Chez Hello Watt, le frontend est un pilier de l'expérience utilisateur : courbes de consommation, pilotage d'appareils en temps réel, parcours de souscription, design system partagé entre React et Django, tu seras au cœur de l'expérience de centaines de milliers de foyers, sur le web comme sur iOS et Android.
Nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeurs-euses. Nous cherchons à garder une qualité de code et une facilité de maintenance élevés, tout en embrassant les nouvelles pratiques et workflows IA.
Tes missions :
- Faire vivre et évoluer Firebolt, notre design system (Tailwind + composants React et Django) en facilitant l'intégration et l'adoption par les développeurs-euses full-stack.

- Veiller à des temps de chargements rapides pour tous sur l'app et le site hellowatt.fr (SEO, Core Web Vitals).

- Implémenter le frontend de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android).

- Définir les pratiques et les outils communs du frontend, faire converger l'existant : data-fetching, formulaires, state management, conventions de composants côté Django/htmx.

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Élargir la couverture et les outils de tests du frontend : tests de composants et de hooks (Vitest, Testing Library), scénarios end-to-end (Playwright), Storybook.

- Passion frontend : forte curiosité et veille active de son écosystème: supports des nouvelles fonctionnalités navigateurs, frameworks, tooling, patterns

- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- Architecture système : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement frontend avec React et TypeScript, dans un environnement produit exigeant sur l'expérience utilisateur.

- À l'aise avec le rendu côté serveur et l'approche hypermedia: Templates Django, htmx, Alpine.js ou similaires.

- Habitué à travailler et/ou définir un design system.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, composition, architecture modulaire par domaines métier.

- Apprécié : notions de Python/Django pour naviguer entre vues et templates, expérience du mobile hybride (capacitorjs).

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire.

- Bac +5 université ou équivalent

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Frontend web app & native apps
- Language : TypeScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Librairies: Tanstack Query, React Router, Lingui

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Radix ui, Storybook

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

Frontend Web
- Language : Django templating language & TypeScript

- Librairies: Htmx, Alpinejs

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Alpinejs, Storybook

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce & Payments
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Make Replit the single place where businesses can buy everything they need through their agents. As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll set technical direction and build the commerce platform that lets users discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage the products and services they need to build and run their businesses—without leaving Replit.

 

Replit already enables businesses to accept payments through integrations such as Stripe. This role builds on that foundation to expand what businesses can buy and accomplish through Replit Agent. You’ll design commerce experiences that combine the simplicity consumers expect with the controls enterprises need, making agent-assisted purchasing useful, trustworthy, and reliable.

 

You’ll own architecture and lead cross-team delivery across merchant and service-provider integrations, agent tools, purchasing workflows, and the lifecycle after a transaction. The challenge goes beyond executing a payment: agents need to understand what a user wants, present clear choices and costs, act within delegated authority, and verify that the purchase delivered the intended outcome. You’ll stay hands-on with design and code while aligning partners, mentoring engineers, and turning an ambitious product vision into incremental customer value.

Set the architecture and technical roadmap for agentic commerce, making Replit a single place to discover, buy, and manage the products and services businesses need.




YOU WILL:

 - Lead end-to-end purchasing experiences through Replit Agent: translate user intent into relevant options, communicate prices and terms, obtain appropriate authorization, execute purchases, and confirm fulfillment or provisioning.

 - Build extensible integrations with merchants, software vendors, and service providers so the platform can expand its commerce offering without rebuilding each workflow from scratch.

 - Build on existing Stripe and payments capabilities, extending payment integrations where needed to support new purchasing experiences rather than treating basic payment acceptance as a greenfield problem.

 - Design agent-facing APIs and tools with clear contracts, secure credentials, scoped permissions, spending limits, and appropriate confirmation for consequential actions.

 - Partner with product and security to support enterprise purchasing requirements such as role-based access, approval workflows, purchasing policies, and auditable transaction histories, while keeping simpler purchases easy.

 - Own the purchase lifecycle beyond checkout: provisioning and access, order and subscription state, receipts, renewals, cancellations, refunds, and reconciliation across providers.

 - Make agent-driven transactions reliable with idempotency, verified events, durable state, safe retries, and recovery from partial failures; evaluate whether workflows complete the authorized task without duplicate purchases or unintended spend.

 - Lead ambiguous initiatives across teams, define incremental milestones, stay hands-on with implementation, and raise the engineering bar through mentoring, design reviews, and production ownership.
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical leadership on complex customer-facing products or platforms, taking ambiguous initiatives from architecture through launch and production operation across multiple teams.

 - Strong hands-on engineering and system design skills, including API design, data modeling, distributed workflows, and thoughtful evolution of existing systems.

 - Experience building extensible third-party integrations and handling asynchronous events, duplicate requests, partial failures, and changing provider capabilities.

 - Strong product judgment: you can turn complex, multi-step workflows into simple user experiences and balance rapid delivery with correctness and long-term flexibility.

 - A security-conscious approach to authentication, authorization, credentials, sensitive data, and actions performed on a user’s or organization’s behalf.

 - Demonstrated ability to align engineering and cross-functional partners on technical direction, document decisions clearly, and drive execution without relying on reporting authority.

 - Experience mentoring engineers and improving the quality of architecture, implementation, and operations beyond your own projects.

 - Comfort using AI-assisted development tools while taking responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of the code you ship.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building commerce platforms, marketplaces, purchasing or procurement systems, or products that connect buyers with multiple vendors.

 - Experience with agent tool calling, multi-step agent workflows, or evaluations for reliable execution of actions against external systems.

 - Familiarity with payment and purchase lifecycles, including authorization, checkout, subscriptions, fulfillment or provisioning, refunds, and reconciliation.

 - Experience building enterprise capabilities such as approval workflows, role-based access, purchasing policies, budget controls, or audit trails.

 - Experience with Stripe or other payment providers, developer platforms, or partner integration ecosystems.

 


BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience with emerging agentic-commerce protocols, MCP, or delegated authorization for agent-initiated transactions.

 - Experience integrating software and service catalogs, pricing and availability, entitlements, or automated provisioning.

 - Familiarity with recurring and usage-based costs, renewal management, international purchasing, or multi-provider transaction workflows.

 - These are additional strengths, not a checklist; prior experience spanning every commerce domain or payment provider is not expected.



WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Customer outcomes: success means a business can get what it needs through its agent, with clear costs and a verified result—not merely a completed API call.

 - User control and trust: agents act within explicit authority, surface consequential choices, and make purchases and ongoing commitments understandable.

 - Consumer simplicity and enterprise readiness: straightforward experiences should coexist with the controls organizations need.

 - End-to-end ownership: we own the experience from intent through purchase, fulfillment, and ongoing management.

 - Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on what exists, deliver incremental value, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter.

 - Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed.
   



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av tv-abonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

jobs.title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals
jobs.description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor / Associate Professor, and Curator of Mammals at Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark wishes to appoint a Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals (mammalia) with a great vision for natural history museums in a changing world. Duties are divided equally between collection-based research and other museum duties including curation of the mammal collections, research-based teaching and supervision of students, public engagement work, and to act as the museum's liaison with relevant Danish natural history communities. The successful applicant will be expected to establish and develop an externally funded collection-based research programme/group and publish in influential journals. We particularly encourage applications from applicants with a collection-based research specialization on mammalogy. The successful applicant will be expected to curate the museum’s historically important mammal collections (56.000 specimens) requiring a thorough understanding and practical knowledge of mammal classification. We value collaboration across disciplines and professions. All applicants are expected to demonstrate interdisciplinary thinking and a commitment to working together to create solutions to global challenges. This also goes for collection work. Curators develop the collections that they are responsible for through research, field work, loan activities, digitization, acting as scientific host for visiting researchers, and increasing accessibility for everyone. This curatorial position in Mammalogy at the Natural History Museum Denmark will be filled at either the Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level. All curators at the Natural History Museum Denmark are expected to take a leading role in society as advocates for science and nature, creating impact at all levels while actively promoting the museum’s Vision and Values (https://snm.dk/en/about-museum). Further details of qualifications required for appointment at the museum are detailed below.

The position is available starting March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Qualifications
Tenure-track assistant professor
Applicants at the tenure track assistant professor level are expected to have an academic record demonstrating the potential to deliver high profile internationally competitive research in the area of specialization. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have experience with collection-based research. Previous experience curating natural history collections and university teaching experience would be advantageous but is not a requirement at the time of hiring for tenure-track assistant professors. Documented interest in and experience with public engagement and community-based activities is expected. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar institution is an advantage.

Associate professor
Applicants at the associate professor level are expected to have a strong publication record in high-level, international, peer-reviewed venues in the area of specialization and a track record of successful external research funding. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have significant experience with collection-based research. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar is expected. Curatorial expertise and considerable previous experience and impact with curating and developing natural history collections is required at associate professor level. Broad experience and a compelling vision for public engagement and community-based activities is essential. Candidates are also required to have documented university-level competencies in delivering high-quality undergraduate/graduate teaching and must be able to explain and reflect upon their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

Assessment of applicants
Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research as well as their curatorial experience and potential to curate one or more of the museum’s collections. Teaching and public engagement qualifications and experience will be considered according to career level. The overall fit for the Natural History Museum will also be considered.
Ideal applicants will have the following qualifications:

  • An outstanding reputation for high-quality research within Mammalogy
  • A record of scientific use of museum collections and/or data
  • A proven track record of interdisciplinary research
  • Scientific expertise that ensures ability to curate Mammalia collections held by the museum
  • Curatorial experience improving and developing natural history collections
  • Experience from a natural history museum or similar
  • Participation in national and international museum collaborations through organizations and programs.
  • A vision for how digital, genomic, and other new technologies will drive advances in natural history science
  • Ability to work at a strategic level
  • A track record of public engagement and creating impact beyond academia
  • Experience working on museum exhibitions, interpretation, and/or public engagement
  • Experience in fundraising and ability to attract research funding from external sources for research, digitization and collection development.
  • Supportive and collaborative people skills and commitment to an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and respect for everyone with equality and opportunity for all
  • A passion for the vision and values of the Natural History Museum Denmark
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Confidence in ability to provide advocacy for the museum with multiple stakeholders
University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor/associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.
For tenure-track assistant professors
For associate professors

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

Information on the tenure-track programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period, tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

About the Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark is the Danish national museum for nature. We work to empower citizens to connect with nature with the aim to create positive change for people and planet. We want to inspire, engage, and enable people to enjoy, understand, and care for the diversity of the natural world. The impact of climate change and anthropogenic forces on biodiversity has reached a critical point. We firmly believe that natural history museums can and should play a key role towards a more sustainable relationship with nature. We are opening a new Danish national museum for nature in spring 2027. One big museum site, in the Botanical Garden, in the centre of Copenhagen, will host state-of-the-art laboratories, outstanding research collections, new public galleries, and combined facilities for programming, education, and citizen science. It is an ambition for the museum to enhance natural history and inspire curiosity, knowledge, and empowerment for the future. The Botanical Garden was founded in 1600, and the museum’s collections date back to Ole Worm’s Cabinet of Curiosities from around 1620. With 14 million preserved specimens and living plants of 8,000 different species in the Botanical Garden, it is the largest museum collection in Denmark. It covers our planetary history with botanical, zoological, and geological specimens from all over the world. Read more about the Mammalia collection here.

The Natural History Museum Denmark is part of the University of Copenhagen, which was founded in 1479 and is the largest university in Denmark. Read more about the museum here.
Inquiries about the position can be made to Museum Director Nina Rønsted (e-mail: nronsted@snm.ku.dk).

Affirmative action
The Natural History Museum Denmark is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or disabled status. We are actively promoting a strategy to improve the gender balance among scientific staff. Copenhagen is a highly diverse and international Scandinavian capital with a green profile. Education is free and childcare is subsidized. Public transport is well developed, and most Copenhageners take their bike to work. There are lots of green areas in and around Copenhagen, the water in the harbor is clean enough for swimming, and the city has multiple museums and other cultural venues.

Terms of employment
Employment is as tenure-track assistant professor/associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The successful applicant is expected to take Danish lessons if there is no prior knowledge of Danish language. The International Office at the University of Copenhagen can help.
This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPHs extensive support for international researchers here

How to apply
The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • A cover letter stating the motivation for applying (1 page)
  • Research profile: description of previous, current and future research plans (3 pages)
  • Curatorial area, experience, vision, and interests (1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae documenting:
    • Previous positions at museums, universities, or other research or cultural institutions
    • Fundraising experience
    • International network and relations
    • Curatorial experience (curation of collections)
    • Public engagement activities, i.e. citizen science projects, exhibitions, popular lectures or other relevant activities
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc- and MSc-students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Diplomas (MSc and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • A cover letter stating the motivation for applying (1 page)
  • Research profile: description of previous, current and future research plans (3 pages)
  • Curatorial area, experience, impact, vision, and interests (1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is November 2 2026 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. We work thoroughly with this process. Several professionals from different fields must be involved. Therefore, we will not be ready for interviews until February 2027.

You can read about the recruitment process here.

jobs.title: Researcher in Geology-Petrology
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Position as Researcher available in Geology-Petrology at the Njord Centre, Department of Geosciences, University of Oslo Norway.

The appointment is a fulltime position until 31 of December 2028.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than January 2027.

Place of work is Njord Centre, University of Oslo at Blindern, Oslo.

Njord is a cross-disciplinary Geology-Physics center hosted by the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at the University of Oslo. We focus on the fundamental physics of geological processes related to transport and reactions in deformable porous media, fracturing and fragmentation processes, interface dynamics during geophysical flows, and intermittency and pattern formation in geological systems far from equilibrium.

We conduct research on earth systems that range in scale from atoms to continents and apply methods where fieldwork, numerical modelling, experiments, and theory act in concert.

The center includes the Oslo-branch of PoreLab, which is a Center of Excellence (CoE), the former CoE, Physics of Geological Processes (PGP) and several externally financed projects. There are ten professors and associate professors at the center, in addition to doctoral research fellows, postdoctoral fellows, researchers and technical and administrative staff - in total about 75 persons.


Project description

We seek a geoscientist who will conduct research within the DecarbFaroe project (https://decarbfaroe.fo/), which is funded by the Research Council of Norway in the framework of the EU Clean Energy Transition Partnership call. This project involves nineteen partners from academia, public research institutes, and industry. DecarbFaroe seeks for a better understanding how carbon dioxide can be mineralized in old basalts of the North Atlantic Volcanic Province that are now exposed in the Faroe Islands. The ultimate goal of the project is to establish a pilot site for carbon dioxide injection and mineralization.

Within DecarbFaroe, the successful candidate will conduct research in geology, petrology, and hydrogeology. The research will be carried out in close collaboration with Jarðfeingi, the Faroese Geological Survey. The researcher will characterize basaltic rocks and their mineralization using state of the art analytical techniques (e.g., scanning electron microscopy, X-ray tomography), interpret borehole logging data and the analysis of rock cuttings, and conduct the hydrogeological characterization of the injection site and analyze pumping tests.

The researcher is expected to integrate into the project team, collaborate with other researchers, contribute to project deliverables in the form of scientific publications, and present results at DecarbFaroe events and international conferences.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Geology. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and completed defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Structural geology and petrology
  • Experience with imaging techniques such as scanning electron microscopy, electron bask-scattered diffraction, X-ray microtomography

Desired qualifications:

  • Hydrogeology and analysis of pumping tests
  • Skills in programming (e.g. Matlab, Python)
  • Faroe Islands geology

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Attention to detail
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 605 000 - 770 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity) 
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

Please see Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.

jobs.title: Vild med matematik og natur/teknologi? Alkestrupskolen mangler dig i indskolingen og på mellemtrinnet!
jobs.description:
Alkestrupskolen søger en energisk og nærværende uddannet lærer, der brænder for at skabe spændende, engagerende og tryg undervisning. Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

Om stillingen: Din primære opgave bliver at skabe succesoplevelser med matematik og natur/teknologi i indskolingen og på mellemtrinnet.

  • Matematik.
  • Natur/Teknologi.
  • Det er et plus, hvis du også kan dække fag som Håndværk og Design, Musik eller Madkundskab.

Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du træder ind ad døren med masser af pædagogisk energi og et hjerte, der banker for børnenes trivsel og faglige udvikling. Du er god til at opbygge relationer, trives i et tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger og kan lide at gøre undervisningen nærværende og levende. Vi har alle lidt kant – det har du også!

Hvad tilbyder vi? På Alkestrupskolen bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med gode kolleger, søde børn og plads til forskellighed:

  • Stærkt kollegafællesskab: Du bliver en del af en engageret personalegruppe, hvor vi løfter i flok, passer på hinanden, og hvor der er plads til faglighed og udvikling - og til at være præcis den, du er.
  • Overskuelige rammer: En mindre skole, hvor alle børn og voksne kender hinanden.
  • Opbakning og natur: En meget engageret forældrekreds samt fantastiske udearealer og natur, der oplagt kan inddrages i undervisningen.

Det praktiske:

  • Arbejdstid: Fuldtid
  • Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt.
  • Ansøgning: Vi opfordrer dig til at tage kontakt til enten Souschef Christopher Folkvard tlf.: 51 16 68 22 eller skoleleder Merete Fledelius tlf.: 24 91 76 32 for et besøg på skolen fra uge 39 og frem.
  • Send din ansøgning: Vi foretrækker, at du sender din ansøgning online. Klik på ”Søg stillingen” og vedhæft din ansøgning og dit CV.
  • Ansættelsessamtaler: Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

I Køge Kommune bliver du en del af en organisation med dedikerede medarbejdere, der hver dag forenes i et fælles mål om at skabe værdi for borgerne. I kommunen ser vi mangfoldighed som en ressource, og ønsker at fremme ligestillingen. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge stillingen – uanset køn, etnisk oprindelse, religion, alder eller eventuel funktionsnedsættelse.

Så bliv en del af holdet! Vi tilbyder dig et forskelligartet arbejdsmiljø og en lang række forskellige personalegoder, såsom sociale aktiviteter og adgang til vores feriehuse.

Læs mere om Køge Kommune på www.koege.dk

jobs.title: Pyhätunturi Oy, määräaikainen vuoropäällikkö Alavuokraamoon
jobs.description:
Olisiko aika astua vuoropäälliköksi Pyhän alavuokraamon tiimille? Lukaise alhaalta vaatimukset ja hae mukaan!

Haemme Alavuokraamon vuoropäällikkö määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työt alkavat marraskuun alussa. Työsuhde on määräaikainen talvikaudelle 2026 – 2027. Pää työtehtävinäsi on vuokraamon päivittäisen työn organisointi ja ohjaaminen, tiimiläisten tukeminen, asiakaspalvelu sekä henkilökunnan perehdyttäminen. Työskentelemme aamu-/iltavuorossa sekä viikonloppuisin. Etsimämme henkilö on oma-aloitteinen, valmis ottamaan vastuuta ja pystyy toimimaan myös paineen alla. Työskentelet yhdessä Storen ja Kultakerovuokraamon esihenkilöiden kanssa.

**Näillä taidoilla homma sujuu ja luistaa:**

- Sinulla on reilusti aiempaa kokemusta vuokraamo työskentelystä

- Osaat ohjata ja johtaa tiimiläisiäsi

- Tunnet välinevuokraamoiden toimintatavat

- Sinulla on valmius työskennellä etenkin iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin sekä huippusesongeissa kuten joulu, hiihtolomat ja pääsiäinen


**Näillä taidoilla erotut eduksesi:**

- Sinulla on aiempaa vuoropäällikkö/ esihenkilö kokemusta

- Tunnet Hiihtokeskus TES:in

- Tunnet hyvin eri lasketteluvälineet

- Olet kiinnostunut kartuttamaan lisää tietoa ja taitoa hiihtokeskuksella työskentelystä


**Miksi tulla juuri meille talvikaudeksi:**

- Tarjoamme reippaan ja vaihtelevan työympäristön kehittyvässä ja vilkkaassa hiihtokeskuksessa

- Saat hyvät harrastusmahdollisuudet

- Meillä on hyvät henkilökuntaedut laskettelun ja liikkumisen parissa


Työsuhteet alkaa sopimuksen mukaan marraskuun alussa ja päättyy toukokuun alussa.

Tarjoamme vuoropäällikölle puhelinedun.

Palkkaus on Hiihtokeskus TES:n mukainen.

Työtehtäviin, yritykseen sekä alueen muihin palveluihin perehdytämme erikseen työsuhteen alussa.

Lisätietoja antaa Hanna Virta, hanna.virta@pyha.fi

Suosittelemme jättämään hakemuksen mahdollisimman pian, sillä haastattelemme hakijoita myös ennen hakuajan päättymistä. Paikat täytetään sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

**Hakemukset 4.10.2026 mennessä. Olemme yhteydessä hakijoihin jo hakuaikana.**

jobs.title: Etsitään kokenutta hitsaajaa
jobs.description:
**Etsitään asiakkaallemme Jamenet Oy:lle kokenutta hitsaajaa!**

Jamenet Oy on vakavarainen jo 40 vuotta alalla toiminut yritys. Laitekantaan panostetaan oikeasti – taloon on valmistunut ja hankittu viime aikoina 5 uutta konetta. Nyt etsimme tiimiin uutta rautaista ammattilaista!

**Etsimältämme tekijältä löytyy:**

- **Vahva hitsaus osaaminen:** Olet todellinen alansa ammattilainen ja sinulta sujuu täytehitsaus isolla langalla ja isolla koneella.

- **Monipuolisuus:** Katsomme suureksi eduksi koneistusosaamisen sekä valmiuden asennus- ja muihin konepajahommiin.

- **Asenne ja ilmapiiri:** Olet itseohjautuva ja rehti tekijä, jolta löytyy sopivassa suhteessa rentoa asennetta ja huumorintajua arjen tekemiseen.


**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- **Vakituisen työsopimuksen** vakavaraisessa ja varmassa yrityksessä.

- **Joustavan päivätyön:** Mahdollisuuden sovittaa työaikoja.

- **Nykyaikaiset työvälineet** ja toimivan laitteiston.

- **Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen.**


**Rekrytointiprosessi:** Rekrytointi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Heimon kanssa. Ensimmäisessä vaiheessa haastattelu järjestetään verkossa Heimon kanssa, minkä jälkeen jatkoon valitut hakijat etenivät haastatteluun suoraan asiakasyrityksen Jamenet Oy:n kanssa. Asiakkaan haastattelun yhteydessä suoritetaan myös työnäyte.

**Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa! Haethan paikkaa mahdollisimman pian.**

Jos sinulle jäi kysyttävää tai haluat jutella työstä lisää, Henkilöstöpalvelu Heimolta Aleksandra Gukkina, aleksandra.gukkina@hpheimo.fi p. 044 744 7031 vastaa kysymyksiisi mielellään. Täytäthän hakemuksen kyseisen työpaikkailmoituksen kautta. Työt alkavat heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

GDPR-säännösten mukaisesti emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä ansioluetteloita tai hakemuksia. Jätäthän hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi suoraan rekrytointijärjestelmäämme. Rekrytointiprosessissamme hyödynnämme tekoälyteknologiaa

_Henkilöstöpalvelu Heimo luo uudenlaista työnteon ja työn tarjoamisen kulttuuria. Ketterässä ja kokeneessa Heimossa työtä tehdään henkilökohtaisella otteella, rehdisti. Heimotyö-, Heimorekry- ja Heimopäällikkö-palvelut pitävät huolen siitä, että työt löytävät tekijänsä, tekijöillä riittää töitä ja työt tulevat tehdyksi._

jobs.title: Group Controller
jobs.description:
Mercell is the leading SaaS platform for public procurement in Europe.

We deliver digital solutions for public tenders and procurement across Europe and have built a large, subscription-based business with a strong Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) foundation. Headquartered in Oslo, Mercell is backed by Thoma Bravo, one of the world's leading software and technology investors.

At Mercell, we're on a mission to transform public procurement by making it more accessible and effortless for everyone involved. We envision a world where public buyers and suppliers work seamlessly together to make “a great deal easier” and help shape the future.

Our culture is built on continuous growth, trust and collaboration. We offer an international environment where talented people can thrive alongside ambitious colleagues who are passionate about creating value for our customers and shareholders.

Your Mission 

As Group Controller, you will join our Group Finance team in a broad, hands-on role spanning financial controlling, FP&A and finance operations. Your work will cover areas such as cost controlling, reporting, forecasting, cash management and working capital.

You will work closely with colleagues across Finance and the business, taking ownership and contributing where needed. This is an opportunity to build on your accounting or audit experience, broaden your operational understanding and grow across several areas of finance.

Core Responsibilities  

  • Contribute to financial reporting, analysis and controls, ensuring reliable numbers and useful insights.

  • Support cost controlling, budgeting and forecasting in certain areas in close dialogue with the business.

  • Support with cash management, cash forecasting and working capital to support day-to-day financial operations.

  • Contribute to effective operations around transfer pricing and inter-company financing; internal cost allocation, internal funding and other financial management on legal entity level

  • Improve processes and ways of working, combining attention to detail with a practical, hands-on approach.

Required Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting, Finance or similar.

  • Strong experience (ideally a minimum of 3-5 years) in accounting, auditing or financial or business controlling, with a solid understanding of financial reporting and analysis. Big4 background is an advantage.

  • An interest in moving closer to the business and developing broader experience in financial reporting and operations.

  • Good Excel skills and confidence working with financial systems and data. Experience with Oracle Netsuite is an advantage.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate across teams.


Preferred Qualifications  

  • You are curious, structured and enjoy getting things done. You take responsibility for the quality of your work, ask questions and are keen to understand how the numbers connect to everyday operations.

  • You enjoy variety and working in a small team where colleagues support each other. You bring a sound technical foundation and a willingness to learn; experience across every part of the role is not expected. Cash management and other operational finance activities offer opportunities to develop as you grow in the role.

  • You are proactive and thrive in a fast- paced environment where we set ambitious goals and continuously improve how we work

  • You have high professional standards.

 

Start date: As soon as possible
Duration: Full time
Workplace type: Hybrid - working onsite at the office min. 3 days and from home, balancing flexibility with collaboration
Location: Oslo, Norway
Application Deadline: 11 October 2026. However, do not wait to submit your application - we will read applications and talk to potential candidates as we receive them 

 

What we offer 

Mercell offers an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of a leading European SaaS company backed by one of the world's foremost technology investors.

You will join an ambitious, international organisation where you can develop and improve financial controlling and finance operations, while broadening your experience across Finance.

We offer a dynamic working environment, excellent opportunities for professional and personal growth, modern offices and a competitive compensation package.

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/pages/perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.

Has this sparked your interest?

Then we can't wait to have you join our mission and looking forward to receiving your application!

-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mercell is the largest public tendering and bidding platform for European buyers and suppliers, dedicated to enhancing connectivity between public buyers and suppliers. We make tenders compliant and easy, while enabling equal opportunity for all suppliers to the public sector.

At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionise public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Siitä on tietysti hyötyä, jos olet työskennellyt vastaavissa tehtävissä jo aiemmin, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä – me perehdytämme kyllä!

🛒S-marketin myyjänä teet ihan tavallisia töitä:työpäiväsi täyttyvät asiakaskohtaamisista, kassatyöstä, hyllytyksestä sekä hävikin ja saatavuuden hallinnasta. jobs.title: Service Desk Specialist
jobs.description:
**We are now looking for an IT Service Desk Specialist** to join our international IT team. This is a hybrid role, requiring presence at our Tornio site approximately 50% of the working time.

**About the role** The IT Service Desk is an essential part of Outokumpus global IT ecosystem. Our team supports employees around the world, resolves technical challenges and helps ensure that the tools and services people rely on every day work reliably.

**As an IT Service Desk Specialist**, you will provide first-line support to users who need help with hardware, software, access rights, networks and other IT-related services. Your work may involve resolving an issue affecting an individual user or contributing to the resolution of incidents with a wider impact on our critical production operations. You will collaborate daily with local and global expert teams. Together, you will solve issues, identify root causes and continuously improve our services.

**What you will do**

- Act as the first point of contact for users seeking technical support via chat, service portal, phone or email

- Investigate and resolve IT issues remotely, gathering the required information for further investigation when needed

- Advise and guide users in the use of IT services and digital tools

- Escalate unresolved issues, or those requiring deeper expertise, to the appropriate support teams

- Document investigations, actions and resolutions in our IT service management system

- Share user feedback and improvement ideas with internal teams to support continuous service development

- Contribute to maintaining the IT knowledge base and identify opportunities to improve ways of working and processes


**What we expect from you**

You will succeed in this role if you are a service-minded problem solver who can remain calm, even in busy or urgent situations. Curiosity and a genuine willingness to investigate, learn and explore new things are critical to success in this role. Not every issue comes with a ready-made answer, which is why we value someone who wants to understand what is causing the problem and find the right solution together with others.

**We hope you have:**

- A degree in IT or equivalent practical experience

- At least one year of experience in a Service Desk, IT support or similar role

- An interest in IT technology and a basic understanding of computer systems, mobile devices and end-user support

- Strong analytical skills and a systematic approach to problem-solving

- Basic knowledge of Windows workstations, Microsoft 365 and Active Directory user administration

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja - ohjaaja
jobs.description:
Ammattilaiset yhdessä lasten parhaaksi.
Koska lasten tulevaisuus alkaa nyt.

Pelastakaa Lapset on maailman johtava sitoutumaton lapsijärjestö ja lastensuojelun edelläkävijä. Ammattilaisiamme Suomessa ja yli 100 maassa yhdistää maailman tärkein tehtävä. Rakennamme parempaa tulevaisuutta lapsille yhdessä lasten, vapaaehtoisten ja kumppaneiden kanssa.

Lupaamme sinulle työpaikan, jossa teemme vaikuttavaa työtä, työskentelemme vahvalla ammattitaidolla ja arvostamme inhimillistä työkulttuuria.

Pelastakaa Lasten palvelutoiminnan kokonaisuuteen kuuluvat kaksi lastenkotia, kolme erityislastenkotia ja yksi perhekuntoutusyksikkö. Palvelutoiminnan tukena työskentelee Pelastakaa Lasten oma nuorisopsykiatri, kehittämispäällikkö sekä kokemusasiantuntijavanhempi. Palvelutoimintamme on ollut SHQS laaduntunnustuksen piirissä vuodesta 2012 alkaen.



Haemme nyt erityislastenkoti Kaislaan Vantaanlaaksoon vakituiseen työsuhteeseen

Sairaanhoitaja - ohjaajaa



Erityislastenkoti Kaisla on Vantaanlaaksossa toimiva kuusipaikkainen sijaishuoltoyksikkö huostaanotetuille kouluikäisille lapsille ja nuorille, joilla on neuropsykiatrisen ja lastenpsykiatrisen erityistuen tarvetta.

Kaisla sijaitsee Vantaalla rauhallisella omakotitaloalueella monipuolisten palveluiden läheisyydessä. Kaislasta on sujuvat kulkuyhteydet lähellä sijaitseviin kouluihin, joiden kanssa tehdään tiivistä yhteistyötä. Myös terveyspalvelut kuten lasten ja nuorten psykiatrian poliklinikat sekä kuntoutuspoliklinikka ovat lyhyen matkan päässä. Lähiympäristössä on hyvät ulkoilu- ja harrastusmahdollisuudet.

Haemme ammattitaitoiseen joukkoomme lastensuojelun sijaishuollon ammattilaista toteuttamaan kanssamme laadukasta ja lapsenoikeusperustaista erityistason sijaishuoltoa. Kaislassa työskentelee kymmenen työntekijän moniammatillinen työryhmä hoitamassa seitsemää lasta. Kaisla on erikoistunut lasten neuropsykiatrisiin haasteisiin. Työmme perustana ovat lapsen oikeudet, lapsen osallisuus, kiintymyssuhdeajattelu ja DKT.

Tehtävänäsi sairaanhoitaja-ohjaajana Kaislassa on huolehtia yhdessä ammattitaitoisen työryhmän kanssa lasten kokonaisvaltaisesta hyvinvoinnista arjessa. Sairaanhoitajana vastaat osaltasi Kaislan lääkehoidosta ja tuet nuoria ja työryhmän työskentelyä nuorten terveydenhuollollisissa asioissa. Omaohjaajana työhösi kuuluu omaohjaajaparityöskentelyä omaohjattavan ja hänen perheensä sekä läheisten kanssa, arjen yhteisöllistä kasvatustyötä, verkostoyhteistyötä ja kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä. Koko työryhmämme perehdyttää sinut työskentelyyn Kaislassa.



Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän arvostetussa järjestössä. Kehitämme rohkeasti uusia toimintatapoja, asetamme kunnianhimoisia tavoitteita ja teemme tinkimättömästi töitä niiden eteen. Haluamme yhdessä rakentaa monimuotoista työyhteisöä ja ilmapiiriä, jossa jokainen voi olla oma itsensä. Ympäriltäsi löydät mukavia ja ammattitaitoisia kollegoita, joista voit olla ylpeä ja jotka ovat ylpeitä sinusta. Sydän paikallaan – se yhdistää meitä kaikkia.



Työsi ja ammatillisen kehittymisesi tueksi tarjoamme:

· kuukausittaiset tiimipäivät ja ryhmätyönohjaukset (mahdollisuus yksilötyönohjaukseen)

· säännölliset psykiatrin konsultaatiot sekä tiimipäivät

· sisäiset- ja ulkoiset koulutusmahdollisuudet

· tarvittavan lisäkoulutuksen lastensuojelun sijaishuollon työskentelyyn

· Pelastakaa Lasten yhteisen arvopohjan

· kattavan sairaanhoitotasoisen työterveyshuollon Terveystalossa

· ePassi hyvinvointiedun



Sinulla on Sairaanhoitaja AMK tutkinto tai aikaisempi opistotason koulutus.

· arvostamme aikaisemman lastensuojelutyön tai lasten- ja nuorisopsykiatrista osastotyön kokemusta ja neuropsykiatrisia ja psykiatrisia täydennyskoulutuksia

· lastensuojelun sijaishuollon osaaminen katsotaan eduksi

· kykyä yksilöllisen ja yhteisöllisen hoito- ja kasvatustyön suunnitteluun, toteuttamiseen ja kehittämiseen

· hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja

· valmiutta tehdä iltapainotteista kolmivuorotyötä (jaksotyöaika 115h/3 viikkoa, kokoaikatyö)



Tehtävä on vakituinen ja työ alkaa 12.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Noudatamme työsuhteessa yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Palkkasi määräytyy aikaisemman kokemuksesi mukaisesti, TES palkkaluokka tehtävässä on G26 (3073,62€–3469,83€). Palkanmaksuprosessimme on kunnossa ja olemme turvallinen ja säännöllinen palkanmaksaja.

Lasten turvallisuus on meille tärkeää kaikessa toiminnassamme ja työntekijöidensitoutuminen lasten suojelemiseen väkivallalta on ehdoton edellytys valinnalle tehtävään, joten tarkistamme rikostaustaotteesi ennen työsopimuksen solmimista (Laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämiseksi 504/2002).
