jobs.title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Trekantsområdet
jobs.description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

 

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

 

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

 

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

 

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Derfor er det ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

 

Med udgangspunkt fra en eller flere af vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabriksleder Tobias Meier Jørgensen på telefon 2871 4678 eller områdechef Kent Florczak på telefon 29254481.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

 

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

jobs.title: Seasonal Worker wanted with forklift certificate – for the pumpkin season 2026
jobs.description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Only applicants with a forklift certificate will be considered for the position.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old.

  • EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

  • Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

  • Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

  • A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

  • Be reliable and arrive on time.

  • Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

  • Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

  • Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

  • Please remember to bring:

  • Sleeping bag

  • Warm clothing

  • Practical work clothes

  • Boots and waterproof clothing

  • Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

  • A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

  • A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

  • Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

  • Tax Information 2026

  • You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

  • If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

  • If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

  • Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@thorsbjerggaard.dk

If you do not hear from us within two weeks, please assume that your application was unsuccessful and that we are unable to offer you a position for 2026.

1. Kierowanie  zespołem do spraw realizacji zadań z zakresu pomocy społecznej, organizowanie pracy podległych pracowników socjalnych oraz nadzór i kontrola nad rzetelnością, jakością i zgodnością ze stanem faktycznym i prawnym sporządzanych przez nich dokumentów.

5. Organizowanie udzielania świadczeń pomocy społecznej - pieniężnej, w naturze i usługach.

Manager / Senior Manager - Forensic & AML - Consulting (m/f/d)

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.
We are diverse and dedicated problem solvers, part of the worldwide network of high-quality audit, tax and advisory services.
We offer excellent career prospects that balance autonomy, flexibility, and responsibility. Our comprehensive benefits inspire our people do and feel their best.

Right now, we have more than 1800 employees from over 70 nationalities. Join our growing group of young and youthful innovators to uncover a world of opportunity together.

Job Description

We are seeking a Manager / Senior Manager in Forensic & AML Consulting

Governance, Regulatory and Compliance continues to be a complex business challenge. As new laws and regulations are introduced, companies' management needs to ensure that corporate governance standards are adhered to and that robust compliance management systems are in place, especially as non-compliance with regulatory requirements is under increased scrutiny from regulators.
In a period of heightened regulatory scrutiny and continuing globalization of AML/CTF regulation, organizations are faced with greater challenges to achieving and maintaining their AML/CTF compliance.

Our Forensic & AML services team, part of our Advisory department is advising clients on how to deal with and meet these regulatory challenges, assisting them in their efforts to prevent, detect and respond to money laundering, corruption and fraud issues.

What you will be working on

• Review, design and implementation of AML/CTF control framework
• Review and preparation of ML/TF risk assessment
• AML/TAX remediation
• AML/CTF compliance assistance
• Provide clients with AML/CTF training and updates Work with a broad range of clients across different industries, with a focus on Asset Management
• Promote our service offerings externally, engage in go-to-market and business development efforts, including the preparation of proposals for prospective clients and client presentations, marketing materials
• Maintain an awareness of current marketplace issues and stay up-to-date with emerging regulatory requirements and guidance
• Actively participate in the management and development of Junior Advisers to Assistant Managers

What we look for

• University degree or equivalent in Business, Economics, Law or other relevant subjects
• 7 to 12 years of experience in AML/CTF/KYC, fraud, bribery and corruption, sanction regimes within the financial sector, or a similar experience within a consulting firm with similar activities
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg and international AML/CTF regulatory framework
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to apply sound reasoning when delivering services to clients
• Strong attention to details, ability to manage teams and multiple priorities
• Fluency in English & French and/or German

What will you get

KPMG is where you will find the right opportunities to advance your career and the widest available range of possibilities so you can grow professionally. Make a real impact, join a diverse team of leading experts, work with global clients, and discover technological solutions.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing and Communications (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Head of Marketing and Communications (m/f/d)

Job Description

As Head of Marketing and Communications, you are accountable for shaping, amplifying, and protecting the firm's strategic priorities, growth agenda, and market positioning. Working closely with Executive Leadership, Business Development, and Sector Leads, you translate business strategy into compelling narratives, integrated go-to-market approaches, and high-impact marketing and communications activity.You lead the end-to-end marketing and communications agenda, spanning brand, reputation, digital, campaigns, events, internal communications, and employer branding. You explore and embed AI-enabled, insight-driven ways of working across all activities to deliver measurable commercial, reputational, and engagement impact.

AI is reshaping how clients discover expertise, consume content, engage with the firm, and make buying decisions, while also transforming the speed, skills, controls, and operating model required within Marketing and Communications. The role must therefore lead a deliberate shift in ways of working—redesigning processes rather than simply adding tools, strengthening data and content governance, building AI literacy and adoption across the team, and maintaining human judgement, creativity, brand integrity, and accountability.

This transformation must be closely connected to Business Development, sector priorities, and the firm's growth agenda, using AI and market insight to identify opportunities, sharpen propositions, personalise engagement, accelerate go-to-market activity, and improve pipeline conversion and commercial impact.

What you will be working on

Strategy, Planning & Leadership

• Translate business priorities into integrated marketing and communications plans.
• Partner with Business Development and Sector Leads to support growth, demand generation, and pipeline development.
• Drive governance, prioritization, and performance measurement across all marketing activities.
• Ensure consistent brand positioning, messaging, visual identity, and storytelling.

External Communications & Reputation

• Lead media relations, public relations, executive communications, and thought leadership.
• Support firm-wide initiatives and manage reputational risks.

Digital Marketing, Campaigns & Demand Generation

• Develop and execute digital, social media, and multi-channel marketing campaigns.
• Oversee SEO/SEM, paid media, marketing automation, and analytics.
• Use data and insights to optimize performance and commercial impact.

Events, Sponsorships & Partnerships

• Lead strategic events, sponsorships, memberships, and partnerships that enhance brand visibility and client engagement.

Internal Communications & Employer Brand

• Drive internal communications and employee engagement initiatives.
• Partner with HR to strengthen employer branding and talent attraction.
• Ensure alignment between employee experience and external reputation.

AI, Transformation & Operations

• Embed AI capabilities across marketing and communications to improve insight, creativity, efficiency, and effectiveness.
• Redesign processes and operating models to support AI-enabled ways of working.
• Ensure appropriate governance, quality control, compliance, and data protection.

Financial & People Leadership

• Own the marketing and communications budget and resource allocation.
• Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team.
• Build capabilities in digital marketing, analytics, AI, and storytelling.
• Manage agency and vendor relationships.

What we look for

• Significant leadership experience (minimum 15 years) across Marketing and Communications, ideally within professional services, financial services, or another complex, regulated, knowledge-led environment.
• Proven ability to translate business strategy into impactful marketing and communication plans.
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders.
• Extensive experience in brand management, communications, content strategy, and storytelling.
• Strong expertise in digital marketing, campaigns, social media, SEO/SEM, marketing automation, and analytics.
• Commercial and data-driven mindset, with the ability to demonstrate business impact.Experience leading transformation, change management, and AI adoption initiatives.
• Knowledge of GDPR and communications compliance requirements.Proven people leadership skills with experience building high-performing teams and fostering collaboration.
• Native English level. Additional languages relevant to Luxembourg's international environment are an asset.

Skills and Experience

Strategic Leadership

• Proven ability to translate business strategy into measurable marketing and communications plans
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders

Brand and Creative Direction

• Deep experience in brand positioning, creative briefing, content strategy, and storytelling, constantly pushing for creative ways to push the brand while adhering to brand guidelines where necessary.

Digital Marketing and Analytics

• Hands-on expertise in SEO/SEM, paid media, marketing automation, social platforms, and analytics
• Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to connect activity to commercial impact

Operational Excellence

• Budget ownership, vendor and agency management, contract negotiation, and scalable process design

Regulatory Awareness

• Familiarity with GDPR and professional services compliance requirements

Leadership and Collaboration

• Proven people leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and change management capability

Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate

Description du poste

Intitulé du poste
Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate
Type de contrat CDI
Temps de travail Temps plein
Référence 2026-1246  

Activités / Missions

Présente au Luxembourg depuis plus de 100 ans, la Banque de Luxembourg est un acteur financier incontournable de la place au service de clients privés, des entreprises luxembourgeoises et de clients professionnels issus des métiers de la gestion d'actifs. Certifiée B Corp depuis 2023, notre Banque s'engage à renforcer l'impact social, sociétal et environnemental de ses activités.

Envie d'accompagner et de financer les grands projets qui transforment le Luxembourg ?

Le pôle Immobilier de notre département Entreprises et Entrepreneurs accompagne les acteurs incontournables du secteur immobilier à Luxembourg en leur offrant des solutions de financement structurées et une expertise conseil de premier plan. Notre force ? Un ancrage local fort et une capacité à intervenir sur tous les métiers de l'immobilier.
Nous intervenons comme un véritable partenaire stratégique dans l'ensemble des activités de nos clients :
La promotion immobilière
L'investissement immobilier
La construction

En tant que Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate, vous gérez de manière autonome un portefeuille de clients professionnels de l'immobilier et les accompagnez dans leurs projets et dans leurs besoins bancaires quotidiens.

• Vous étudiez les demandes de financement d'acteurs professionnels du secteur immobilier : vous analysez la faisabilité économique et financière de projets immobiliers et étudiez les rapports financiers ;
• Vous rédigez et structurez les demandes de crédits, proposez des solutions de financement en ligne avec l'appétit risque de la banque et défendez les dossiers devant les comités compétents ;
• Vous collaborez avec le département Crédit et Juridique afin de réaliser la documentation juridique et contractuelle relative au financement ;
• Vous assurez le suivi des opérations financées, veillez à une utilisation correcte des fonds et anticipez les risques éventuels ;
• Vous contribuez à la réalisation de crédits syndiqués (club deals) avec d'autres banques ;
• Vous développez et entretenez un réseau solide auprès des principaux acteurs de l'écosystème et représentez la banque à l'occasion d'évènements pour participer à son rayonnement ;
• Vous développez de nouvelles relations clients et identifiez des nouvelles opportunités pour atteindre vos objectifs commerciaux ;
• Vous assurez la revue périodique des engagements et vous veillez au respect des exigences de conformité des comptes (KYC, KYT, AML etc.)

Profil

De formation Bac+5 en sciences économiques, commerciales ou financières, vous avez au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans un établissement bancaire au Luxembourg avec une expérience de minimum 5 ans dans le domaine des financements immobiliers ;
• Vous disposez d'excellentes connaissances en matière de crédits, d'analyse bilantaire et financière, et vous maîtrisez les concepts de financement de projets ;
• Vous disposez d'une expérience avérée dans les financements syndiqués ou financements en club deal et êtes familiers avec les contrats LMA ;
• Vous justifiez de connaissances approfondies liées au marché et aux technicités de l'immobilier au Luxembourg et connaissez les principaux acteurs locaux ;
• Vous disposez d'une proactivité et d'une autonomie forte et êtes orientés résultat ;
• Votre aisance relationnelle, votre sens de la négociation couplée à votre orientation client et à votre engagement professionnel font de vous un interlocuteur apprécié, capable d'établir une relation privilégiée avec les clients ;
• Rigoureux·euse, flexible et organisé·e, vous êtes également doté·e d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse et de bonnes aptitudes rédactionnelles ;
• Vous parlez couramment le français et l'anglais, la maîtrise du luxembourgeois et/ou de l'allemand constitue un avantage.

Convaincus que notre diversité fait notre force, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de la Diversité, Lëtzebuerg. Attentifs à l'égalité des chances, nous nous engageons à travers des actions concrètes, notamment en faveur des jeunes talents, des femmes, des collaborateurs seniors…

Vous souhaitez …

• rejoindre des équipes composées de femmes et d'hommes d'horizons multiples, aux parcours et compétences complémentaires ,
• vous développer dans un cadre de travail respectant l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle ;
• évoluer dans un environnement propice à l'épanouissement de tous les talents…

Adressez-nous votre CV accompagné d'une lettre de motivation via notre Espace Candidats.

Pour information, un extrait du casier judiciaire de moins de 2 mois vous sera demandé avant la conclusion de tout contrat de travail.

jobs.title: MLAĐI/A PROCESNI/A RADNIK/CA
jobs.description:
Organizacijska jedinica: Proizvodnja, Postrojenje za proizvodnju AN/KAN 2 Opis poslova:
  • Sudjelovanje u primopredaji smjene s procesnim radnikom iz prethodne smjene
  • Obilazak postrojenja, očitavanje procesnih parametara, unošenje podataka u radne liste
  • Sudjelovanje u praćenju procesa proizvodnje na upravljačkoj ploči sukladno uputama za rad
  • Upisivanje rezultata dnevnih analiza javljenih iz Kontrole kvalitete
  • Informiranje smjenovođe o uočenim poremećajima i kvarovima u procesu proizvodnje
  • Poduzimanje korektivnih aktivnosti u cilju normalizacije procesa u suradnji sa smjenovođom i iskusnijim procesnim radnikom
  • Sudjelovanje pod stručnim nadzorom u rukovanju opremom na radnom mjestu u startu, normalnom radu i zaustavljanju postrojenja
  • Sudjelovanje pod stručnim nadzorom u preventivnom pregledu opreme, vizualna zapažanja
  • Uzimanje uzoraka pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Provođenje mjera integriranih sustava upravljanja Društva
  • Primjena pravila ZNR i ZOP
  • Održavanje čistoće na svom radnom mjestu
  • Određivanje pH taline amonijevog nitrata, određivanje koncentracije amonijevog nitrata i uzimanje uzoraka u trećoj smjeni pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Održavanje prohodnosti slivnih limova ispod transportera granulacijskog tornja i održavanje čistoće svih odvodnih kanala u postrojenju
  • Održavanje čistoće (prikupljanje rasutog proizvoda) svih transportera i ostalih uređaja u postrojenju
  • Pranje fluidizacijskog hladnjaka, čišćenje i pranje sita i drobilice, čišćenje i pranje sustava za povratnu frakciju
  • Uključivanje sustava za aminizaciju proizvoda pod stručnim nadzorom (čišćenje dizni, prepumpavanje amina)
  • Rukovanje kompresorom pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Sudjelovanje u obavljanju održavalačkih radova za vrijeme remonta i zastoja postrojenja te obavljanje manjih održavalačkih radova za vrijeme normalnog rada postrojenja te sudjelovanje u poslovima preventivnog održavanja po potrebi
  • Ostali poslovi po nalogu neposrednog rukovoditelja, sukladno potrebama posla, osposobljenosti i osobnim radnim mogućnostima
Uvjet:
  • SSS – strojarski, elektrotehnički ili kemijsko tehnološki smjer
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo u struci.
Traženi profil kandidata:
  • izražene organizacijske vještine
  • spremnost na timski rad
  • odgovornost i pouzdanost.
Nudimo Vam:
  • ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad 6 mjeseci
  • naknadu troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla
  • naknadu za prehranu
  • prigodne nagrade (uskrsnica, regres, božićnicu) sukladno odrebama Kolektivnog ugovora I odlukama Uprave
  • uslugu prehrane u restoranu unutar tvorničkog kruga
  • priliku za rad na raznovrsnim i zanimljivim radnim zadacima u dinamičnom poslovnom okruženju
  • mogućnosti za učenje na radnom mjestu i izvan njega.
Ako ste u navedenom radnom mjestu prepoznali izazov za svoju karijeru i udovoljavate navedenim uvjetima, prijavite se na email adresu: karijera@petrokemija.hr najkasnije do 27.9.2026. godine. Razmatrane će biti samo pravovremene i potpune prijave (životopis i dokazi o ispunjenju uvjeta) pristigle pristigle na naznačenu e-adresu. U prijavi obavezno naznačiti radno mjesto za koje se prijavljujete. Više o nama saznajte na www.petrokemija.hr

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Core DevOps
Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

Omalt poolt pakume: • stabiilset tööd rahvusvahelises ja arenevas ettevõttes;

jobs.title: Senior QA Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenriscreations.com/en/postings/d315eb37-715d-4657-b29d-484420749257
Application deadline 8th of october 2026

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our growing legal team and serve as a strategic partner to our rapidly expanding enterprise sales organization. In this high-impact role, you'll drive complex commercial negotiations that fuel our growth, working closely with our sales teams to close sophisticated technology agreements with enterprise customers across diverse industries. You'll play a critical role in scaling our commercial legal processes while navigating the evolving landscape of AI-powered development tools and ensuring our customers can confidently deploy Replit's platform in their organizations.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive Enterprise Deals: Serve as the lead legal advisor for complex, high-value enterprise sales transactions, working directly with our Account Executives and customer legal teams to negotiate and close sophisticated software agreements

 - Navigate AI & Technology Compliance: Help enterprise customers understand and navigate the legal and regulatory implications of adopting AI-powered development tools, addressing data privacy, security, and compliance requirements across various industries

 - Build Scalable Frameworks: Design and implement contract playbooks, template agreements, and streamlined processes that enable our sales team to move quickly while maintaining legal rigor as we scale

 - Risk Management: Identify, analyze, and proactively manage complex commercial and legal risks while maintaining deal velocity in our fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and Privacy teams to ensure our commercial offerings align with product capabilities and regulatory requirements

 - Strategic Advisory: Provide strategic guidance to leadership on commercial legal matters, emerging AI regulations, and market trends affecting developer tools and enterprise software adoption

 - Customer Relationship Building: Foster strong relationships with enterprise customer legal teams, becoming a trusted advisor who helps facilitate smooth adoption of Replit's platform




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Legal Foundation: JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar

 - Commercial Experience: 5-7 years of relevant legal experience supporting enterprise software sales and complex commercial transactions, preferably at high-growth technology companies

 - Technology Focus: Strong background in SaaS agreements, software licensing, and technology transactions, with bonus points for experience with AI/ML tools, developer platforms, or cloud infrastructure

 - Deal Velocity: Proven track record of successfully closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in fast-paced environments while balancing legal risk with business objectives

 - Business Acumen: Exceptional business judgment and ability to provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice that enables (rather than blocks) commercial success

 - Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives and enterprise customer stakeholders

 - Startup DNA: Thrives in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments where you'll need to build processes from the ground up and adapt quickly to changing priorities

 - Collaboration: Collaborative mindset with a track record of building strong cross-functional relationships and supporting high-velocity sales processes




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - In-House Experience: Previous in-house counsel experience at technology companies, particularly those serving enterprise customers or developer audiences

 - AI/Developer Tools: Experience with AI, machine learning, or developer platform companies, including understanding of the unique legal considerations around code generation and AI-assisted development

 - Industry Knowledge: Experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries or understanding of compliance requirements across different sectors

 - Scale Experience: Experience supporting sales teams through hypergrowth phases, including building legal processes that scale with rapid revenue expansion


This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
jobs.description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires
- Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de clients et partenaires ;
- Représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur : entreprises, bureaux d'études, architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, partenaires industriels ;
- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires sur les marchés ciblés ;
- Participer à la structuration des méthodes commerciales et du suivi client ;
- Contribuer au développement des activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives.
Profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée en chargé d'affaires, conduite de projets, développement commercial BTP, construction métallique, ingénierie ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne compréhension des dossiers techniques, plans, métrés, chiffrages et contraintes chantier ;
- Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires en parallèle avec rigueur et autonomie ;
- Aisance dans la relation client, la négociation et la coordination d'interlocuteurs variés ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer son activité ;
- Profil terrain, réactif, fiable et orienté solutions ;
- Une expérience dans la construction métallique, le bâtiment industriel, l'enveloppe du bâtiment ou les structures métalliques serait fortement appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compréhension technique et commerciale, nous recherchons une personne capable de prendre en main des affaires de manière autonome, de sécuriser le suivi des projets et de contribuer concrètement au développement du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration
- CDI ou collaboration selon profil ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des clients / partenaires ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

jobs.title: Junior kampagne specialist for Google Ads i Barcelona
jobs.description:
Er du klar til at forlade Danmark og det regnfulde vejr til fordel for den livlige, spændende og smukke by Barcelona? Og kunne du tænke dig at tilføje værdifuld arbejdserfaring med Google Ads til dit CV? Så er dette måske noget for dig!

Barcelona er hjemsted for mange store kunstnere og malere, så der er altid masser af kunst at udforske. Byens mest berømte kulturelle mesterværk er Gaudís værk, den imponerende katedral "Sagrada Familia," som repræsenterer en unik stil inden for moderne arkitektur.

Hvis du ikke er så vild med kunst og kultur, kan du tilbringe dagen på en af Barcelonas sandstrande, som kun ligger en kort gåtur fra byens centrum. Her kan du nyde noget af det bedste middelhavsinspirerede seafood. Byen har et ry for at være den mest kosmopolitiske, moderne og fremsynede by i Spanien. Selvom det er en meget moderne by, finder du stadig de gamle kvarterer som det gotiske kvarter, hvor byens ældste bygning ligger, samt utallige barer og butikker.

Vi tilbyder

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke og bonussystem

  • Udviklingsmuligheder inden for virksomheden

  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger, sociale arrangementer og et kontor med havudsigt

  • Relocation-pakke (Betalt fly til Barcelona og den første måneds husleje betalt + økonomisk bolig støtte din anden måned)

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Gratis fitnessmedlemskab

  • Præstationsbonusser

Om jobbet:

Som junior kampagne- og marketingspecialist vil du være ansvarlig for at forbedre og udvikle kampagner. Derfor vil du skulle rådgive og have gode forhandlingsevner – det er ikke aggressivt salg, men det er vigtigt, at du besidder nogle salgsmæssige kvaliteter. Dit daglige arbejde vil inkludere opgaver som:

  • Fungere som en betroet konsulent og onboarde kunder

  • Udvikle PPC-kampagner

  • Forstå kundernes behov og mål

  • Ansvar for at øge forbrug, mersalg og bæredygtighed

  • Håndtere en stor mængde potentielle kunder dagligt via telefonopkald

Dine kvalifikationer

Du taler dansk på modersmålsniveau og er flydende i engelsk (B2).

Erfaring: Minimum 1-2 års erfaring inden for salg og/eller online annoncering. Erfaring med outbound-opkald og salg (ikke påkrævet). BA/BS i Marketing, Digital Marketing eller Kommunikation er et plus.

Du har en god forståelse og et solidt niveau af computerfærdigheder.

Fremragende problemløsningsevner med evnen til at finde og identificere de rette oplysninger. Du har erfaring med og en passion for online display-annoncering.

Stærke kommunikations- og forhandlingsevner. Du er serviceorienteret, professionel og grundig.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at sende en mail til Cll@jobsqd.com


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Prentari / Printer
jobs.description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Hæfniskröfur:
Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Um Prentmet Odda:

Prentmet Oddi er stærsti framleiðandi landsins á kartonumbúðum, almennu prentverki og bókum. Félagið vinnur jafnframt með mörgum af öflugustu umbúðaframleiðendum Evrópu til að veita fyrirtækjum heildarlausnir á sviði umbúða. Prentmet Oddi þjónustar meginþorra af kröfuhörðustu fyrirtækjum landsins og hefur gert það í áratugi með hraða, gæði og persónulega þjónustu að leiðarljósi.

Áhugasamir umsækjendur eru hvattir til að sækja um starf á:

🔹 https://alfred.is/starf/prentari-oskast-6

eða

🔹 https://www.prentmetoddi.is/prentmet-oddi/atvinnuumsokn

Nánari upplýsingar má einnig fá með því að senda fyrirspurn á isi@prentmetoddi.is.

Við leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur metnað fyrir gæðum, tæknilega færni og áhuga á að taka þátt í framleiðslu á fyrsta flokks prentverkefnum.
Umsóknarfrestur er til og með 12 september 2026

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Prentmet Oddi is seeking a responsible, detail-oriented, and motivated Offset Printer to join our production team.
This is a varied and challenging position within a dynamic manufacturing environment where quality, service, and professionalism are key priorities.

Key Responsibilities:
Operate and oversee offset printing presses.
Inspect and compare proof sheets and printed sheets to ensure production quality.
Perform routine machine maintenance and maintain maintenance records.
Provide guidance and answer questions regarding printing processes and technical matters.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
Carry out other related duties as required.

Qualifications:
Experience in offset printing or a similar production environment is an advantage.
Strong technical aptitude and ability to work independently.
Excellent attention to detail and organized work practices.
Positive attitude and strong teamwork skills.
Commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

Salary will be based on the applicant's experience, knowledge, and qualifications.
Employment terms are governed by the collective agreement of Grafía (The Icelandic Printing and Media Union).
Working hours are 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday through Thursday, and 8:00 AM to 3:30 PM on Fridays.

Prentmet Oddi is Iceland's largest producer of carton packaging, commercial print products, and books. The company also collaborates with some of Europe's leading packaging manufacturers to provide comprehensive packaging solutions for businesses. For decades, Prentmet Oddi has served many of Iceland's most demanding companies, with a strong focus on speed, quality, and personal service.

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their application through one of the following links:

🔹 https://alfred.is/starf/prentari-oskast-6

🔹 https://www.prentmetoddi.is/prentmet-oddi/atvinnuumsokn

For further information, please contact:

📧 isi@prentmetoddi.is

Join a leading Icelandic printing and packaging company and become part of a team committed to excellence, quality, and innovation.

Application deadline is September 12th, 2026

jobs.description:

THREE STEPS IS A SOCIAL CARE BASED, TRAUMA AND ATTACHMENT INFORMED, CLINICALLY SUPPORTED RESIDENTIAL CARE SERVICE PROVIDER. We work closely with the HSE, Tusla (Child and Family Agency) and the Northern Ireland Trusts and have a number of centres for children and adults with disability. We also provide residential care services for children and young people in care. All our services are currently located in Meath. As part of the launch of our new Pilot Programme in the Meath Area, Three Steps is seeking Level 5 and Level 6 qualified candidates in health-related disciplines to join our teams. This pilot programme is designed to support and develop skilled healthcare practitioners while continuing to deliver safe, compassionate, and professionally informed care to children, young people, and adults in our services. Three Steps care team members work with all our partners to provide safe, compassionate, and professionally informed care to the children, young people and adults placed in our centres. Together, we work hard to improve the quality of care we provide every day. We put the children, young people and adults in our care first in everything we do, and as a company, we invest heavily in our care teams to ensure they have the skills, support and encouragement they need to achieve our shared aims. Our contract options can be tailored to your availability, with both full-time or part-time options available. Benefits include: Comprehensive Training Programme Detailed Induction process Strong team support structures, including regular professional supervision and an established on-call process Independent Employee Assistance Programme Option to work fulltime / part-time / Relief 3 weeks paid sick leave per year Enhanced annual leave for long-serving team members Attractive salary, DOE. Onsite parking If you are able to care for vulnerable children, young people and adults and are willing to work hard, to learn and develop as a healthcare practitioner, we would like to hear from you. If you are interested in joining our team, you will need to have the following qualifications and experience: A minimum Level 5 qualification in the area of Healthcare, Healthcare Support, Social Care, Disability Studies, or another related and relevant field. Qualifications considered as related and relevant are: Psychology, Child and Adolescent Psychotherapy, Youth and Community Work, Social Work, Social Sciences, Teaching, Nursing, Early Childhood Studies, Special Needs Assistant, Disability Studies, Childcare, Addiction Studies (not exhaustive). You will also need... The ability to relate to and care for vulnerable children, young people, and adults and to demonstrate a genuine respect for them, their parents and families. jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking a Maintenance & Lifestyle Services Inspector to join our team and oversee property inspections and maintenance requirements for both private and commercial clients. The successful candidate will be responsible for visiting properties following client move-outs, assessing the condition of the property, identifying works required, and providing clear and accurate reports and recommendations. The role will involve working closely with clients, contractors and internal management to ensure that required works are arranged and completed to a high standard. This is a hands-on and client-facing position requiring excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple properties and maintenance requirements effectively. Key Responsibilities Visit residential and commercial properties following move-out inspections. Inspect properties and identify maintenance, repair and remedial works required. Compile detailed inspection reports and clearly communicate required works. Liaise directly with clients regarding property condition and recommended works. Obtain and coordinate required maintenance and repair services. Arrange works with appropriate contractors and service providers. Monitor and oversee maintenance works to ensure they are completed appropriately and within agreed timescales. Keep accurate records of inspections, works required, works arranged and completion status. Communicate regularly with senior and internal management regarding property maintenance requirements. Coordinate with in-house management where other services are required. Provide support to the wider operation as required. Key Skills & Experience The ideal candidate will have: Experience in property maintenance, inspections, facilities management, property services or a related field. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify maintenance and repair requirements. Excellent communication and client-management skills. Strong organisational and time-management abilities. The ability to coordinate multiple jobs and contractors simultaneously. Good report-writing and administrative skills. A practical understanding of property maintenance and repair works. The ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with senior management and colleagues. A professional and customer-focused approach. About the Position This role is primarily focused on property inspection, assessment, coordination and oversight of maintenance and remedial works. The successful candidate will work closely with in-house management, who will coordinate other property services such as cleaning. Managing cleaning operations will not form part of this role's remit. The position offers an opportunity to take responsibility for an important part of the property services operation while working directly with private and commercial clients and supporting the senior management team. Salary: €36,605 per annum

jobs.title: Kundeservice søges til Malta - Betalt relokation
jobs.description:
Kundeservice søges til Malta – God løn, bonus og relocation-pakke

Kunne du tænke dig at kombinere en international karriere med livet på Malta?

Vi søger lige nu en dansktalende Kundeservice til en langsigtet stilling hos en international bank på Malta.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor du arbejder med danske kunder og får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice, salg og den finansielle sektor.

Stillingen er særligt interessant for dig, der allerede har erfaring med kundeservice eller salg – og måske har erfaring som Team Leader eller med KPI'er og dataanalyse.

OM JOBBET

Som Kundeservice bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer kundeservice, onboarding, salg og betalinger.

Du vil blandt andet:

• Besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon, live chat, email og SMS

• Hjælpe kunder med information om bankens produkter, services og betalinger

• Håndtere spørgsmål og henvendelser fra danske kunder

• Arbejde tæt sammen med betalings- og collectionsafdelingen

• Følge gældende procedurer, regler og lovgivning

• Arbejde med salg og aktivt identificere relevante salgsmuligheder

• Sikre en professionel og effektiv kundeoplevelse

Du refererer direkte til den danske Team Leader og bliver en del af et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

HVORFOR MALTA?

Malta er en populær destination for danskere, der ønsker at kombinere arbejde med livet i udlandet.

Her får du mulighed for at bo på en middelhavsø med et internationalt miljø, gode strande, restauranter, et aktivt socialt liv og masser af muligheder for at opleve øen.

Virksomheden arrangerer blandt andet ugentlige Friday Drinks og forskellige sociale arrangementer, hvor du kan lære dine kollegaer og Malta bedre at kende.

jobs.title: Pædagogisk assistent til vuggestue
jobs.description:
Børnehytten søger en dedikeret pædagogisk assistent til vores vuggestue.

Hvem er vi: 

Vi er en privat integreret daginstitution beliggende i hjertet af Kettinge. Vi er normeret til 12 vuggestuebørn og 29 børnehavebørn. Vi har tæt samarbejde med forældrebestyrelse og det lokale forenings- og forretningsliv.

Huset rummer nærhed, omsorg og sammenhold for børnene såvel som for kollegaerne. Vi har fokus på trivsel og tryghed og vægter derfor bl.a. forældrekontakten højt. Vi er gode til at arbejde sammen og spille hinanden gode i hverdagen. Grundet husets størrelse er der en naturlig god relation til børnene på tværs af stuerne og vi kan hurtigt træde til på alle stuer, hvis behovet opstår. 

Børnehytten støder op til en tidligere grusgrav, der nu fungerer som rekreativt område med bålhytte, naturlegeplads, kunstige søer med fisk og mange andre muligheder for udfoldelser med børnene. Derudover har vi vores egen legeplads der er opdelt i vuggestue og børnehave, hvor vi prioriterer at børnene kommer ud hver dag. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du nyder at være en del af udelivet uanset vind og vejr, da vores børn også elsker at hoppe i vandpytter, kigge på biller og finde regnorme.

I vuggestuen er værdien af tid central for vores pædagogiske arbejde. Tid til nærvær, tid til fordybelse og tid til at skabe små betydningsfulde øjeblikke der danner fundamentet for børnenes læring, udvikling, trivsel og dannelse. Vi har fokus på at skabe udviklende læringsmiljøer, hvor alle børn – uanset behov og forudsætning -har mulighed for at deltage i meningsfulde fællesskaber.

Vi forventer af dig:

Du er uddannet pædagogisk assistent og gerne med erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet. Du er empatisk, omsorgsfuld og vægter arbejdet med relationer højt. Du er nysgerrig og legende i din tilgang til børnene og vægter tid, tillid og tryghed højt hos både store og små.

Du skal have en naturlig interesse og nysgerrighed på sproglig udvikling og brugen af det i hverdagen.

Du kan i samarbejde med dine kollegaer på stuen, planlægge aktiviteter og evaluere disse med udgangspunkt i den nye styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

Du kan samarbejde med din kollegaer, om at vurdere børnenes trivsel og udvikling og ved behov iværksætte konkrete tiltag. Du skal kunne se det enkelte barn og bidrage til at udarbejde handleplaner, indstillinger, koordinere tværfagligt samarbejde med mere.

 

Om stillingen:

Vi tilbyder en ansættelse hurtigst mulig eller fra 1/11-26 i en 32 timers stilling efter gld. overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23/9-26 Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 40.

Kontakt gerne leder: Tinni eller souschef Stine - 53841514 - Man-Fredag kl. 9-15, for mere information.

jobs.title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You'll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system purpose-built for second-level controls on NAV computation in investment funds. The system must retrieve relevant regulatory methodology, replicate calculation steps, detect discrepancies against fund accounting outputs, and produce control reports that are traceable, auditable, and defensible under regulatory scrutiny.
You will contribute to a system where precision, explainability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

Code Development (60%):
·          Build retrieval pipelines optimised for structured regulatory methodology documents (CSSF circulars, ESMA guidelines, fund prospectuses), with adaptive weighting to surface the specific calculation rules relevant to each control query
·          Implement numerical validation pipelines that compare LLM-derived NAV calculation outputs against fund administrator figures, applying configurable tolerance bands and discrepancy flagging logic
·          Implement chunking strategies optimised for fund accounting reports and regulatory circulars, preserving the structure of calculation tables, formula references, and numbered regulatory provisions.
·          Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports
·          Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published

Research & experimentation (25%):
·          Benchmark embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline, with a focus on sensitivity to numerical and regulatory language in fund accounting contexts
·          Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance
·          Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels
·          Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions.

System integration (15%):
·          Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output
·          Implement comprehensive logging, structured audit trail generation, and monitoring dashboards that allow compliance officers to review and challenge control decisions

PHD IN SPIN PHOTON ENTANGLEMENT GENERATION WITH COLOUR CENTRES IN SILICON CARBIDE (m/f)

Temporary contract | 14+22(+12) months | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be part of the LIST Materials Research and Technology department, where you will carry out your work in the Quantum Materials Group, led by Dr. Florian Kaiser.
Quantum technologies have the potential to revolutionise the world in many aspects. Quantum colour centres in in wide bandgap semiconductors have recently emerged as a promising platform, since they can incorporate quantum systems, which can be scaled up by industrial processing. Along these lines, we have recently shown that individual colour centres can be integrated into silicon carbide nanophotonic waveguides with little-to-no degradation of spin-optical coherences. These finding define the strategy for developing a scalable quantum technology architecture.
Our strategy is to use multiplexed and integrated colour centres for quantum communication tasks. Key here is to generate entanglement between colour centres based on spin-photon entanglement, as well as Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. With this milestone demonstration, we strive to kickstart subsequent developments towards a quantum internet architecture.

The objective of this PhD thesis is to support our work towards optical interference between colour centres, i.e., Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. The initial part of this thesis comprises setting up our new optical cryostat platform, which is based on a combination of standard confocal microscopy, and interferometry. In the second step, you will benefit from our ongoing activities towards quantum photonic silicon carbide chips in which we generate colour centres in fibre-coupled waveguides.
You will determine the ideal pulsed excitation schemes for colour centres, considering spectral, temporal and polarization filtering. Subsequently, you will characterise the photon quality depending on experimental parameters, and implement initial two-photon inteference experiments outside of the cryostat, followed by a fully-on-chip demonstration inside the cryostat. If time permits, this project can be further extended to the generation of entanglement between two colour centre chips located in two different cryostats.

LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
In 2024, LIST and GOODYEAR signed the second phase of their partnership, 2024-2029, building on the outcomes of their previous collaboration and entering new technological areas as well. GOODYEAR-LIST partnership 2.0 embraces Luxembourg's National priorities, such as Sustainability, Digital transformation and Circular economy, through the execution of five Strategic Research Programs: Data Science for Tires, Tire as a Sensor, End-of-Life Tire Valorization, Sustainable Materials for Non-Pneumatic Tires, Sustainable Materials for Next Generation of Pneumatic Tires, Structure-Process-Properties Relationships.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is seeking to recruit a two-year postdoctoral position to work on the fabrication on Li-ion microbatteries. The project is part of a large R&D framework between Goodyear company and LIST including one topic dealing with the development of “smart tires”. In this general context, the main objective of the project in which the postdoctoral candidate will be integrated is to explore how the configuration of an area of microbatteries can be optimally designed to obtain the best coupling with an energy harvester empowering device.
As such, the selected candidate will have (i), to fabricate and characterize solid state microbatterie(s) (ii), explore how to promote their optimal charging when they are powered by an energy harvester, (iii) work on the integration of such devices in a model tire.
More precisely, together with the teams of LIST scientists in the field of materials dry synthesis, microfabrication or microelectronics, the candidate will be involved in the experimental/operational fabrication of the materials needed for the realization of microbatteries, the control of their internal interfaces, their integration for the realization of the microdevices, as well as their structural/chemical characterizations and electrochemical performances determination (ionic conductivity measurement, areal capacity determinations in liquid or solid electrolyte, rate capacity, etc.). He will additionally have to work on the final protection of the fabricated Li-ion microbatteries. The candidate will be located at LIST (Belvaux) and will have regular contacts with the company.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

·        You hold a PhD degree with demonstrated theoretical and practical knowledge in Materials science/Material chemistry and Li-ion battery electrochemistry.

Experience and skills

·        Proven and mandatory hands-on experience in materials chemistry, Li-ion microbattery fabrication and characterization as well as cleanroom microfabrication.
·        Good experience with structural and chemical characterizations using state-of-the art techniques (SEM, DRX, XPS, etc.)
·        Experience in PVD and/or ALD is a plus.
·        High-level scientific and technological track record related to material chemistry and/or Li-ion battery is a plus.
·        Strong communication and interpersonal skills;
·        The candidate should be motivated by working with an industrial partner;
·        Collaborative skills, initiative, autonomy, result oriented and capacity to work in an interdisciplinary environment.


Language skills

·        Fluency in English both oral and written.
·        Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

·        Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·        Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·        An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
·        Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
·        Multicultural and international work environment with more than 50 nationalities represented in our workforce
·        Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·        Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
·        32 days paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·        Flexible working hours, home working policy and access to lunch vouchers


Apply online

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.
